연합 모함의 정련로를 맡는다. 아그니와 같은 온도에서 같은 색을 읽는다: Runs the alliance mothership's refinery. She reads the same colors at the same temperatures as Agni — only Igna never gives those colors names.
부품 라인을 한 번에 다 외운다. 처음 보는 도면인데도 손이 먼저 기억한: Learns a parts line by heart in one go. Even with a blueprint she's never seen, she says her hands remember it first.
합성로 냄새로 배합을 맞춘다. 연합 모함의 연료가 조금 더 진하다는 말이: Sets the blend by the smell of the synthesis furnace. There's talk that the alliance mothership's fuel runs a little richer.
연합 모함의 심장을 지킨다. 전력표 맨 아래 칸은 비워 둔다 — 누구 이: Guards the heart of the alliance mothership. She leaves the bottom row of the power chart blank — she says she hasn't decided whose name to write there yet.
창고 장부를 연합원 모두의 이름으로 연다. 누가 무엇을 보냈는지는 적지: Opens the storehouse ledger in the names of every alliance member. She doesn't record who sent what — her sister told her to do it that way.
Doesn't throw away even a single nail. So many of this ship's parts came from other ships.
격납고 번호를 부르는 목소리가 하르파와 닮았다. 부르는 번호는 하나씩 앞: Her voice calling out hangar numbers sounds like Harpa's. The numbers she calls are each one earlier.
연합 모함의 항로를 정한다. 지휘관 칸이 여럿인 배라, 누구의 말을 먼저: Sets the alliance mothership's course. It's a ship with several commander slots, so she starts by deciding whose word to hear first.
Watches more than she teaches. Until the girls find their own mistakes.
연합의 거래 소식을 가장 먼저 듣는다. 값은 마르셰보다 조금 후하다 —: Hears the alliance's trade news first. Her prices are a little more generous than Marché's — her regular customer is the whole alliance.
포대의 조준선을 연합원 모함 쪽으로 한 번씩 돌려 본다. 지킬 곳을 확인: Swings the battery's sightline toward each alliance member's mothership once. A habit of checking what she guards.
Divides the sky like petals and hands out the pieces. If even one is missing, she knows at once.
전류의 세기로 포성을 맞춘다. 볼타와 같은 단위를 쓰는데 숫자는 늘 조금: Tunes the gunfire by the strength of the current. She uses the same units as Volta, yet her numbers always come out a little different.
연합 모함의 신호를 낮게 깐다. 숨기는 것이 아니라 끼어들 틈을 남기는: Lays the alliance mothership's signal down low. Not to hide it, she says, but to leave a gap for others to cut in.
다가오는 것과 멀어지는 것을 소리로 가른다. 유령 선단은 어느 쪽인지 가: Tells what's approaching from what's receding by sound. She says she sometimes can't tell which one the Ghost Fleet is.
Won't entrust the vault key even to the leader. The vault belongs to the whole alliance.
광맥의 빛깔로 수율을 짐작한다. 베릴의 기록과 나란히 두면 꼭 한 줄씩: Estimates yield from the color of the vein. Set beside Beryl's records, hers are always exactly one line ahead.
별로 항로를 고친다. 연합 모함은 혼자 떠도는 배가 아니어서 별을 하나: Corrects the course by the stars. The alliance mothership isn't a ship that drifts alone, so she watches one more star.
Researches ways to reuse what's worn out. This ship has a lot that's worn out.
Blocks with light. People tell her it's a slightly warmer color than Lumen's.
격벽에 연합원 모함들의 문양을 하나씩 새겨 두었다. 빈자리도 남겨 두었다: Carved the emblem of each alliance member's mothership into the bulkheads, one by one. She left empty spaces too.
Runs the engines on the ship's keel side. If Bella is the sail, Carina is what's beneath it.
방어를 연구한다. 습격이 드문 배라 맞은 자국이 모자라, 연구대보다 과녁: Researches defense. This ship is rarely raided, so it's short on hit marks — she sets up targets before the research bench.
연합 모함의 건설 장부를 쥔 참모. 노르마가 항로를 정하면 마르가는 그: The officer who holds the alliance mothership's construction ledger. Once Norma sets the course, Marga decides what to build on it and when. Neither of them knows that the handwriting on the ledger's first page matches Serena's.
\"다음 것은 미리 적어 둬. 연합 몫이니까.\": "Write down the next one ahead of time. It's the alliance's share."
연합 조립 라인의 순번표를 맡는다. 바이아가 이름을 부르면 로사는 그 이: Keeps the turn sheet for the alliance assembly line. When Baia calls a name, Rosa writes down the time that name will come off the line.
\"한 줄씩. 연합 순번은 내가 지킬게.\": "One line at a time. I'll keep the alliance's order."
제작대 앞에 다음 것을 미리 물려 둔다. 도웰이 손을 떼는 순간 이미 다: Clamps the next piece into the workbench ahead of time. The moment Dwell lets go, the next part is already clamped in.
\"제작대가 비는 시간은 없게 할게.\": "I won't let the workbench sit idle."
Runs two docks at once. She grumbles that because of her name she always gets called second.
Fires up the second assembly line. The one who draws one more line on Rosa's turn sheet.
수리 순서를 칠판에 적는다. 연합 모함 칠판엔 다른 모함에서 다쳐 온 이: Writes the repair order on the board. On the alliance mothership's board go the names of girls hurt on other motherships, too.
\"다친 순서가 아니라 급한 순서로.\": "Not in the order they got hurt. In the order it's urgent."
연구 일지를 검은 잉크로만 쓴다. 비앙카와 같은 실험을 하는데 결론은 늘: Writes her research journal only in black ink. She runs the same experiments as Bianca, but her conclusions always start from the opposite end.
\"같은 답이어도 길은 달라.\": "Even with the same answer, the path is different."
첫 화물. 연합 모함 격납고에 처음 서 있던 소녀: The first cargo. The girl who stood first in the alliance mothership's hangar
Wears the same hangar number as Yuki. Only its first digit is one smaller. Sonya doesn't hide that number.
무엇을 실어 왔는지 적지 않는다. 대신 무엇을 두고 왔는지는 정확히 기억: She doesn't record what she hauled in. Instead, she remembers exactly what she left behind.
해 질 녘에만 나가던 버릇: A habit of heading out only at dusk
A habit picked up on her old mothership, she says. She doesn't say that mothership's name.
불꽃처럼 짧은 왕복: A round trip short as a spark
왕복이 짧을수록 웃는다. 오래 비우는 출격에서 누군가 돌아오지 못한 적이: The shorter the round trip, the more she smiles. As if, on some long sortie, someone once didn't come back.
편성의 귀환 순서를 늘 머릿속에 둔다. 누가 마지막인지 알아야 마음이 놓: She always keeps the squad's return order in her head. She says she can't relax until she knows who's last.
조준보다 발사가 빠르다. 늦게 쏴서 잃은 것이 있다고 — 그 이상은 말하: She fires faster than she aims. She lost something once by shooting late, she says — and says no more.
Once she catches fire, she goes all the way. The vanguard of an alliance squad is usually Darya.
She traces the same trajectory as Rin. The two have never met.
빛을 등지고 싸운다: Fights with the light at her back
빛을 등지면 적이 눈을 찡그린다는 걸 오래전에 배웠다. 누구에게 배웠는지: She learned long ago that with the light behind you, the enemy squints. She's forgotten who taught her.
She goes all out only in the brightest hours. She hates the dark corridors.
All she knows is how to hold one spot. The girl who hesitated for the first time when ordered to shift position.
누구에게 한 맹세인지는 적혀 있지 않다. 지키는 쪽은 언제나 연합 모함이: It isn't written whom the oath was sworn to. The side she guards is always the alliance mothership.
The scratches on her armor look older than ours. There's no repair record.
She gives the warmest spot in the hangar to others. She stands by the door herself.
She stands on the side that blocks the light. So the girls behind her aren't dazzled.
She lifts without weighing. Her hands know the weight, she says.
She's the first to know when the ship lists. Liv keeps the alliance mothership balanced.
돌아올 이를 기다리며 짐을 싣는다. 흥얼거리는 노래의 첫 소절이 아카리의: She loads cargo while waiting for those who'll come back. The first bar of the tune she hums is the same as Akari's song.
건져 올리는 손: The hand that pulls things up
Among the wreckage, she looks for signals first. In the same order as Arisa.
물에 뜨는 것은 무엇이든 배라고 믿는다. 그래서 버려진 것을 버리지 않는: She believes anything that floats is a ship. So she doesn't throw away what's been thrown away.
She presses exactly where it hurts. That's how it heals faster, she says.
She knows how to quiet the noise of the Repair Dock. Even a damaged frame needs rest, she says.
She joins torn armor like thread. The seam remains.
She finds something to drink even where there's no water. Alliance squads rest when Alina does.
She calls the names of the girls who came back, one by one. She calls the names that don't answer, too.
She hides words in the noise. She doesn't know who she's hiding them for.
She clouds the scopes. The enemy's, and sometimes ours.
레이더에 비친 자기 모습을 오래 본다. 거기엔 다른 번호가 찍혀 있다고: She stares a long time at her own image on the radar. She says a different number is printed there.
She carries a melody on the airwaves. If Setsuna heard it, she'd say it's a song she's never heard.
She scatters white dots across the whole screen. There are things you can see only between them.
She gives no orders. Instead, everyone looks to her.
She was on the side that guarded the flag, not the side that raised it, she says. On her old mothership.
She takes command when the commander isn't there. On the alliance mothership, that happens often.
She knows the alliance's rules by heart. She doesn't ask who made them.
Word arrives before she does. The word isn't always good.
She believes walls open if you knock. If they don't, knock harder.
She keeps time by the intervals between gunfire. One beat late, and she gets uneasy.
Throwing from far away suits her. If there's no reason to get close.
She uses weight in reverse to send things far. It means giving back as much as you get, she says.
She spends a whole day lining up the guns. Firing takes an instant.
She walks roads that aren't on the map. Then she comes back and draws them on it.
She knows where north is from anywhere. But she sometimes gets confused about which way home is.
She measures position by the stars. Her stars differ from the ones Momo measures by just one.
She reads the footprints others left. The older they are, the better she reads them.
She fires light into the dark corridors. Not to see the way, but to see each other.
She makes openings. Even ones that aren't there.
Once she grabs hold, she doesn't let go. So sometimes she gets dragged along too.
She likes doors with no key. Doors with keys are no fun, she says.
She loosens what's been tightened. She knows how to tighten it again, too.
She digs downward. The way under the wall is the quietest.
The emblem on her shield is the same as ours. Only its number comes earlier.
She knows how to wait. A phalanx that hurries falls apart, she says.
She stacks thin layers, many of them. If one tears, the rest remain.
She grips her blade at the very front of the phalanx. Even behind the shields, she looks ahead.
She guards what's underfoot. The place no one looks.

\"백오십 번. 비계를 걷는 소리가 이제 노래 같다.\" — 노바: "A hundred and fifty. Taking down scaffolding sounds like a song now." — Nova
\"완공 이백. 그쯤이면 처음 지은 벽이 어디였는지 헷갈려.\" — 노바: "Two hundred builds. By then you lose track of where the first wall was." — Nova
\"이백 번. 처음 벽은 아직 그 자리에 있다. 많이 덧대졌을 뿐.\": "Two hundred. The first wall's still where it was. Just patched over a lot." — Nova
\"완공 삼백. 모함이 다 자라는 날은 오지 않아. 그게 좋은 거야.\": "Three hundred builds. The Mothership never finishes growing. That's the good part." — Nova
\"삼백 번. 다 지은 날은 없었다. 늘 다음 공사가 있었다.\" — 노: "Three hundred. There was never a day it was done. There was always the next job." — Nova
\"통제실 Lv.3. 슬롯이 하나 더 — 예고도 하나 더.\" — 소나: "Control Room Lv.3. One more slot — one more warning." — Sona
\"세 편성을 동시에. 이제부터가 항해지.\" — 노바: "Three squads at once. This is where the voyage begins." — Nova
\"통제실 Lv.5. 항로표 다음 장이 열리는 거지.\" — 노바: "Control Room Lv.5. That opens the next page of the route chart." — Nova
\"다섯 항로가 동시에 열렸다. 내가 다 볼 수는 없어 — 그래서 소나가: "Five routes open at once. I can't watch them all — that's what Sona's for." — Nova
\"통제실 Lv.6. 항로표가 한 장으로는 안 접히지.\" — 노바: "Control Room Lv.6. The route chart won't fold into one sheet anymore." — Nova
\"여섯 항로. 소나가 범위를 넓혀 달라고 하기 시작했다.\" — 노바: "Six routes. Sona's started asking for more range." — Nova
\"통제실 Lv.8. 그 너머는 내 표에도 없어.\" — 아스트라: "Control Room Lv.8. Past that, it's not even on my table." — Astra
\"관측소까지 닿는 항로표. 아스트라의 서명이 먼저 있었다.\" — 노바: "A route chart that reaches the observatory. Astra's signature was already on it." — Nova
\"정련로 Lv.10. 화구 열 개를 다 켜면 색이 달라.\" — 아그니: "Refinery Lv.10. Light all ten burners and the color changes." — Agni
\"열 번째 화구가 붉게 붙었다. 이제 스크랩이 모자라는 날은 없다.\": "The tenth burner's caught, glowing red. No more days short on scrap." — Agni
\"정련로 Lv.20. 화구가 스무 개면 밤에도 모함이 밝아.\" — 아: "Refinery Lv.20. Twenty burners, and the Mothership glows even at night." — Agni
\"스물. 색이 오르길 기다리는 일이 조금 짧아졌다.\" — 아그니: "Twenty. Waiting for the metal to glow takes a little less time now." — Agni
\"연구 하나만 Lv.1로. 결재 서명은 내가 해.\" — 베릴: "Just one research to Lv.1. I'll sign off on it myself." — Beryl
\"숫자가 조금 올랐다는 것보다, 누가 재고 있다는 것이.\" — 베릴: "It's not that the numbers went up a little. It's that someone's measuring." — Beryl
\"연구가 시설을 여는 레벨이 있어요. 색인에 표시해서 그 장을 펴 뒀어: "Some research levels unlock facilities. I have marked them in the index and left that page open." — Bianca
\"준비 단계는 끝났다. 결재한 결과표 한 장이 벽 하나를 문으로 바꿨어: "Prep phase done. One signed-off result sheet turned a wall into a door." — Beryl
\"연구 레벨 합 20. 재는 데 시간이 걸려.\" — 베릴: "Research levels total 20. Measuring takes time." — Beryl
\"스무 장의 결과표, 전부 결재. 벽에 붙일 자리가 모자라.\" — 베: "Twenty result sheets, all signed off. Running out of wall." — Beryl
\"연구 레벨 합 40. 결과표 벽을 하나 더 세워야 해.\" — 베릴: "Research levels total 40. Need another wall for result sheets." — Beryl
\"마흔 장. 이제 결과보다 다음 가설이 먼저 떠올라.\" — 베릴: "Forty sheets. The next hypothesis comes before the result now." — Beryl
\"레벨 합 60이면 연구소가 도서관이 된다.\" — 베릴: "At 60 levels in total, the lab becomes a library." — Beryl
\"예순 장. 재는 사람보다 잴 것이 많아졌어.\" — 베릴: "Sixty sheets. More to measure than people measuring." — Beryl
\"레벨 합 80. 결재 서류 서가가 벽 하나를 다 덮어.\" — 베릴: "80 levels in total. Shelves of sign-off papers cover a whole wall." — Beryl
\"여든 장. 오래된 결재 서류를 다시 꺼내 보는 날이 늘었다.\" —: "Eighty sheets. More days pulling out old sign-off papers." — Beryl
\"레벨 합 100. 재는 법을 새로 만들어야 할지도 몰라.\" — 베릴: "100 levels in total. Might need a new way of measuring." — Beryl
\"백 장. 잴 것은 아직 많고, 자는 하나 더 늘었다.\" — 베릴: "A hundred sheets. Still plenty to measure, and one more ruler." — Beryl
\"정비 연구소. 마이카가 왜 부서졌는지를 적어 줄 거야.\" — 리벳: "Maintenance Lab. Mica'll write down why things broke." — Rivet
\"고치는 건 리벳이. 다시 안 부서지게 하는 건 내가 — 기록 한 장씩: "Rivet fixes it. I make sure it doesn't break again — one log sheet at a time." — Mica
\"항법 연구소. 아스트라가 좌표를 늘려 줄 거야.\" — 노바: "Navigation Lab. Astra will stretch the coordinates for us." — Nova
"Where we go: Nova. How fast, how far we see: me." — Astra
\"지하 창고 Lv.5. 보이지 않는 칸이 하나 더 생깁니다.\" — 베: "Underground Vault Lv.5. One more unseen compartment is added." — Berta
\"보이지 않는 자원은 털리지 않습니다. 그것이 제 일의 전부입니다.\": "Resources that cannot be seen cannot be taken. That is the whole of my work." — Berta
\"담당들은 시설만 보는 게 아니야. 들러 주면 알아.\" — 노바: "The keepers don't just watch their facilities. They notice when you drop by." — Nova
\"담당 하나가 지휘관을 믿기 시작했다. 시설보다 사람이 먼저 자랐다.\: "One keeper has started to trust the Commander. The people grew before the facilities did." — Nova
\"담당 셋이 믿어 주면 모함이 돌아올 집처럼 굴러가지.\" — 노바: "With three keepers trusting you, the Mothership runs like a home to come back to." — Nova
\"셋. 복도를 지나가면 인사가 세 번 돌아온다.\" — 노바: "Three. Walk the corridor and three hellos come back." — Nova
\"다른 모함의 순서표까지 세고 있어. 이름은 어디서나 늘어.\" — 하: "I'm counting other Motherships' order sheets too. Names keep growing everywhere." — Harpa
\"모든 격납고를 합친 순서표가 한 장 찼다. 내 칸만이 아니었어.\": "One order sheet filled up with every Hangar combined. It wasn't just my slots." — Harpa
\"클래스 둘. 복기할 조합이 생긴다.\" — 미네르바: "Two classes. Now there are combinations to debrief." — Minerva
\"캐리어 옆에 스트라이커. 실을 소녀와 싸울 소녀 — 편성이라는 말이: "A Striker beside the Carrier. A girl to carry, a girl to fight — the word 'squad' means something now." — Harpa
\"클래스 다섯이면 편성에 답이 여러 개 생겨. 하나씩 복기.\" — 미: "With five classes, a squad has more than one answer. Debrief them one by one." — Minerva
\"다섯 갈래. 상대가 바뀌면 편성도 바꾼다. 다시.\" — 미네르바: "Five branches. The opponent changes, the squad changes. Again." — Minerva
\"일곱 갈래. 모르는 역할이 거의 없어진다.\" — 미네르바: "Seven branches. Hardly a role left unknown." — Minerva
\"일곱. 훈련 교본의 장이 모자라기 시작했다. 다시 쓴다.\" — 미네: "Seven. The training manual is running out of chapters. Rewrite it." — Minerva
\"다섯 명. 이름은 다 외울 수 있어.\" — 하르파: "Five of them. I can remember every name." — Harpa
\"다섯. 한 손에 꼽히는 동안은 다 기억할 수 있어.\" — 하르파: "Five. As long as they fit on one hand, I can remember them all." — Harpa
\"누구든 Lv.5. 첫 성장은 빨라. 방심 금지.\" — 미네르바: "Anyone to Lv.5. First growth is fast. No getting careless." — Minerva
\"레벨 5. 같은 이름이 다시 오면 이제 승급을 시도할 수 있어.\": "Level 5. If the same name comes again, you can try a promotion now." — Harpa
\"Lv.10. 이 아이 출격 일지 첫 권이 반쯤 차.\" — 하르파: "Lv.10. This girl's first sortie log is half full." — Harpa
\"열. 첫 이야기가 열렸다.\" — 하르파: "Ten. The first story has opened." — Harpa
\"칸 하나가 채워졌다. 이름을 부르는 것부터.\" — 하르파: "One slot filled. It starts with calling her name." — Harpa
\"Lv.15에 무장 슬롯이 열려. 도면은 준비됐어.\" — 리벳: "Armament slot opens at Lv.15. Blueprints are ready." — Rivet
\"열다섯. 무장 슬롯이 열리는 레벨이다 — 리벳이 벌써 도면을 들고 왔: "Fifteen. The level where the Armament slot opens — Rivet's already here with the blueprints." — Harpa
\"2칸 소녀 하나. 격납고는 좁아져도, 이름은 외워 둘게.\" — 하르: "One 2-slot girl. The Hangar may get tight, but I'll remember her name." — Harpa
\"두 칸을 쓰는 소녀. 격납고가 처음으로 좁게 느껴져.\" — 하르파: "A girl who takes two slots. For the first time, the Hangar feels small." — Harpa
\"열 명. 순서표 한 장, 이름으로 꽉 차.\" — 하르파: "Ten of them. One order sheet, full of names." — Harpa
\"열 명. 이제 격납 순서표가 필요해. 이름은 다 외웠어도.\" — 하: "Ten. Now the Hangar needs an order sheet. Even though I know every name." — Harpa
\"열다섯 명. 순서표가 두 장으로 넘어가.\" — 하르파: "Fifteen of them. The order sheet runs onto a second page." — Harpa
\"열다섯. 부를 이름이 늘어서, 격납고에 조용한 시간이 없어.\" —: "Fifteen. More names to call, so there's no quiet time in the Hangar anymore." — Harpa
\"조립 열 번. 라인 소리, 익숙해지는 중.\" — 테스라: "Ten assemblies. Line noise: getting familiar." — Tesla
\"열 번의 기동. 서보 정렬이 이제 눈 감고도 돼.\" — 테스라: "Ten activations. Servo alignment: doable eyes shut." — Tesla
\"조립 서른 번. 라인이 손에 익을 때쯤이야.\" — 테스라: "Thirty assemblies. About when the line settles into your hands." — Tesla
\"서른 번의 기동. 라인 소리만 들어도 어느 클래스인지 알아.\" —: "Thirty activations. Class identifiable by line noise alone." — Tesla
\"예순 번. 서보 소리로 컨디션 측정, 가능.\" — 테스라: "Sixty. Condition by servo noise: readable." — Tesla
\"예순 번의 기동. 라인이 나보다 먼저 다음 부품을 기억해.\" — 테: "Sixty activations. The line remembers the next part before I do." — Tesla
\"스무 명. 라인이 쉰 날이 없었다는 뜻, 알지?\" — 루시아: "Twenty girls. That means the line never had a day off, okay?" — Lucia
\"스무 명이면 관제가 아니라 운영. 이름은 다 외워.\" — 하르파: "At twenty, it's not traffic control. It's running the place. I know every name." — Harpa
\"합성 승급 한 번. 실패해도 재료였던 이름은 기억해.\" — 하르파: "One fusion promotion. Even if it fails, I'll remember the names that went into it." — Harpa
\"재료가 아니라 기록이 남았다고 말해 줘.\" — 하르파: "Say it's the record that stayed, not the materials." — Harpa
\"승급 열 번. 복기 기록이 한 장 찬다.\" — 미네르바: "Ten promotions. One page of the debrief record, full." — Minerva
\"열 번. 벽에 적은 승급 이름들이 한 줄로는 안 돼.\" — 하르파: "Ten. The promotion names written on the wall won't fit on one line." — Harpa
\"승급 스무 번. 격납고 벽의 승급 기록이 두 줄이 된다.\" — 하르: "Twenty promotions. The promotion record on the Hangar wall runs to two lines." — Harpa
\"스무 번. 이제 합성실 문이 닫혀 있는 날이 드물다.\" — 미네르바: "Twenty. The fusion room door is rarely shut now." — Minerva
\"A 등급. 순번표도 라인도 같은데 나오는 게 달라.\" — 루시아: "Grade A. Same order sheet, same line, but what comes out is different." — Lucia
\"A. 이 자리는 운으로 오지 않게 됐다.\" — 하르파: "A. This spot isn't reached by luck anymore." — Harpa
\"A 다섯. 이름 다섯으로 편성 하나를 A 로만 짤 수 있어.\" —: "Five A's. Five names, and a whole squad built from A's alone." — Harpa
\"A 가 다섯. 순서표 첫 장 이름들이 한 등급 올라갔어.\" — 하르: "Five at A. The names on the first page of the order sheet went up a grade." — Harpa
\"S 는 명단에 없는 등급. 만들어야 해.\" — 하르파: "S is a grade that isn't on the roster. It has to be made." — Harpa
\"S 는 명단에 없던 등급이다. 만들어졌다.\" — 하르파: "S was a grade that wasn't on the roster. Now it's been made." — Harpa
\"S 셋. 하나는 기적이고 셋은 방침이다.\" — 미네르바: "Three S. One is a miracle. Three is policy." — Minerva
\"S 가 셋. 명단에 없던 등급이 이름 셋으로 한 줄을 채웠어.\" —: "Three S's. A grade that was never on the roster filled a row with three names." — Harpa
\"S 에 Lv.20. 그 다음은 별이다.\" — 미네르바: "S at Lv.20. Next come stars." — Minerva
\"첫 별. 한계라고 적어 둔 줄을 한 칸 지웠다.\" — 미네르바: "First star. I struck one line off what I had written down as the limit." — Minerva
\"별 셋. 가르칠 게 아니라 꺼낼 게 남은 아이.\" — 미네르바: "Three stars. Nothing left to teach her — only more to draw out." — Minerva
\"별 셋. 복기표 칸이 모자라 옆에 덧붙였다.\" — 미네르바: "Three stars. The debrief sheet ran out of boxes, so I added more on the side." — Minerva
\"별을 단 아이가 셋이면 편성이 달라진다.\" — 하르파: "Three girls with stars, and the squad changes." — Harpa
\"셋이 별을 달았어. 격납고 조명이 한 단계 밝아진 기분이야.\" —: "Three have stars now. Feels like the Hangar lights went up a notch." — Harpa
\"클래스 하나 명단 전부. 빈칸이 신경 쓰이지?\" — 하르파: "A whole roster for one class. The empty slots bug you, don't they?" — Harpa
\"한 클래스의 이름이 다 불렸다. 다음은 중복이 아니라 재료다.\" —: "Every name in one class has been called. From here, repeats aren't duplicates — they're material." — Harpa
\"명단엔 안 적힌 이름. 전파에는… 가끔 잡혀.\" — 사일런: "A name not written on the roster. On the air… it gets picked up, sometimes." — Silen
\"명단에 없던 이름이 격납고에 있어. 나도 처음 봐 — 외워 둘게.\": "A name that wasn't on the roster is in the Hangar. First time I've seen it, too — I'll remember it." — Harpa
"A hidden girl comes only when the roster's five are together. Fill another class's roster and another comes." — Harpa
\"둘째 히든. 명단 밖 이름이 명단보다 더 궁금해졌어.\" — 하르파: "Second hidden. I'm more curious now about the names off the roster than the ones on it." — Harpa
\"다섯. 기록 없는 기체가 한 줄. 이름은 내가 외워 뒀어.\" — 하: "Five. Frames with no records fill a row. I've learned their names by heart." — Harpa
\"Lv.20 이면 출격 일지 첫 권이 다 찬다.\" — 하르파: "At Lv.20, the first sortie log is full." — Harpa
\"스물. 두 번째 이야기가 열리는 자리다.\" — 하르파: "Twenty. That's where the second story opens." — Harpa
\"Lv.25. 출격 일지 두 번째 권이 시작됐어.\" — 하르파: "Lv.25. The second sortie log has started." — Harpa
\"스물다섯. 이제 이 아이가 신참에게 요령을 가르친다.\" — 하르파: "Twenty-five. Now she's the one teaching the new girls the ropes." — Harpa
\"한 번은 운, 세 번이면 방법을 안 거야. 기억해 둘게.\" — 하르: "Once is luck. Three times means you know how. I'll remember that." — Harpa
\"세 번. 이제 재료를 고르는 눈이 생겼어.\" — 하르파: "Three. Now there's an eye for picking materials." — Harpa
\"승급 다섯 번. 재료 고르는 기준이 생길 때다.\" — 미네르바: "Five promotions. Time to set a standard for picking material." — Minerva
\"다섯 번. 운 아니고, 순서표대로였어.\" — 하르파: "Five. Not luck. It went by the order sheet." — Harpa
\"Lv.30. 출격 일지 두 번째 권이 반쯤 찬다.\" — 하르파: "Lv.30. The second sortie log is half full." — Harpa
\"서른. 이 아이 후속 이야기가 세 장 열렸다는 뜻이야.\" — 하르파: "Thirty. That means three of this girl's follow-up chapters have opened." — Harpa
\"Lv.40. 교관이 가르칠 게 거의 안 남는 선이다.\" — 미네르바: "Lv.40. The line where an instructor has almost nothing left to teach." — Minerva
\"마흔. 훈련장보다 전장에서 더 많이 배웠다는 얼굴이다.\" — 미네르: "Forty. That face learned more on the battlefield than on the Training Ground." — Minerva
\"Lv.20 다섯. 한 명만 키운 게 아니라는 증거다.\" — 미네르바: "Five at Lv.20. Proof this was never about raising just one." — Minerva
\"다섯이 나란히 스물. 줄 맞춰. 편성을 바꿔도 전력이 흔들리지 않는다: "Five side by side at twenty. Dress the line. Swap the squad and strength holds." — Minerva
\"Lv.50까지 가는 이름은 드물어.\" — 하르파: "Few names make it to Lv.50." — Harpa
\"쉰. 일지가 아니라 연대기다. 표지에 이름을 새겨 둔다.\" — 하르: "Fifty. Not a log anymore — a chronicle. I'll carve her name on the cover." — Harpa
\"열 명, 열 이름을 나란히 올리는 쪽이 더 어려워.\" — 하르파: "Raising ten side by side, ten names together, is the harder way." — Harpa
\"한 명이 빛나는 격납고보다 열 명이 나란한 격납고가 오래 간다.\": "A Hangar where ten stand level lasts longer than one where a single girl shines." — Harpa
\"별 다섯이 첫 이정표야. 그 앞은 자원이 아니라 시간.\" — 하르파: "Five stars is the first milestone. Getting there takes time, not resources." — Harpa
\"별 다섯. 여기까지가 지도에 있는 길이야. 이제부터는 너머다.\" —: "Five stars. This is as far as the map goes. From here on, it's beyond." — Harpa
\"별 다섯 다음엔 도전이야. 재료는 성공했을 때만 가져가.\" — 하르: "After five stars, it's a challenge. Materials are only used up when it succeeds." — Harpa
\"여섯 번째 별. 지도 밖에 첫 발자국이 찍혔어.\" — 하르파: "Sixth star. The first footprint off the map." — Harpa
\"별이 열이면 이름을 새로 붙여야 할지도 몰라.\" — 하르파: "At ten stars, she might need a new name." — Harpa
\"열 번째 별. 이 아이한테서 아직도 꺼낼 게 있었어.\" — 하르파: "Tenth star. She still had more to give." — Harpa
\"아직 이름이 비어 있는 자리가 있어.\" — 하르파: "There are still spots with no name in them." — Harpa
\"모든 종류의 발소리. 이제 어떤 항로도 편성이 막히지 않는다.\" —: "Footsteps of every kind. Now no route leaves a squad stuck." — Harpa
\"말을 걸어 주면 소녀들도 대답을 고른다. 신뢰는 그다음이야.\" —: "Talk to the girls and they pick their answers too. Trust comes after that." — Harpa
\"첫 신뢰. 이 아이가 지휘관 쪽으로 먼저 고개를 돌렸다.\" — 하르: "First Trust. She turned toward you first, Commander." — Harpa
\"유대까지 가면 소녀가 먼저 말을 걸어 온다.\" — 하르파: "Reach Bond, and the girl starts talking to you first." — Harpa
\"첫 유대. 격납고에서 지휘관 발소리를 구별하는 아이가 생겼다.\" —: "First Bond. There's a girl in the Hangar who knows your footsteps now, Commander." — Harpa
\"각별이 되면 지휘관을 이름으로 부른다. 그 다음이 서약이야.\" —: "At Devotion, she calls you by name, Commander. After that comes the Vow." — Harpa
\"각별. 이 아이는 이제 계급이 아니라 이름으로 부른다.\" — 하르파: "Devotion. She calls you by name now, not by rank." — Harpa
\"서약까지 간 이름은 아직 없어.\" — 하르파: "No name has reached the Vow yet." — Harpa
\"서약은 격납고 기록에 남지 않는다. 그래서 내가 대신 적어 둔다.\": "A Vow doesn't go in the Hangar records. So I write it down instead." — Harpa
\"한 명이면 인연, 다섯이면 지휘관의 성격.\" — 하르파: "One is a connection. Five says something about the Commander." — Harpa
\"다섯 명이 같은 말을 했다. 이건 우연이 아니라 지휘관의 성격이다.\: "Five of them said the same words. That's not chance — that's the Commander's character." — Harpa
\"명단 밖 이름은 아직 다 오지 않았어. 오면 외워 둘게.\" — 하르: "Not every name off the roster has come yet. When they do, I'll remember them." — Harpa
\"명단에 없던 이름이 전부 왔다. 이제 명단을 다시 써야겠다.\" —: "Every name that wasn't on the roster is here. I'll have to rewrite the roster now." — Harpa
"As far as the radar reaches, someone keeps clearing. The footprints pile up." — Sona
\"모든 항로의 발자국을 세었다. 밖은 없는 걸로, 안은 다 본 걸로.\: "I counted the footprints on every route. Outside counts as nothing; inside counts as all seen." — Sona
\"첫 출격. 돌아오는 항로는 내가 그려.\" — 노바: "First sortie. I'll draw the way back." — Nova
\"첫 항로. 근교라도 좋아 — 레이더에 점 하나가 움직이기 시작했다.\: "First route. Close by is fine — one dot on the radar started moving." — Sona
\"회수하고 돌아오면 첫 귀환. 빈손도 귀환은 귀환.\" — 소나: "Haul and come back, and that's the first return. Empty-handed still counts as a return." — Sona
\"돌아왔다. 레이더에 다시 잡혔다는 게, 실어 온 것보다 먼저다.\": "Back. Showing up on radar again comes before whatever was hauled home." — Sona
\"무인 채굴 위성. 보이는 데 있는 첫 표적으론 딱 맞아.\" — 소나: "Unmanned Mining Satellite. Just right for a first target, as far as I can see." — Sona
\"경비 드론 넷. 첫 교전 기록이 생겼다 — 다음 좌표는 벨트.\" —: "Four guard drones. The first combat record is logged — next coordinate is the Belt." — Sona
\"폐기 위성 벨트. 스크랩이 좋아 — 화구가 달아올라 기다려.\" —: "Derelict Satellite Belt. Good scrap — the burners are glowing hot, waiting." — Agni
\"요격 드론 열둘을 뚫었다. 격전지가 보이는 데까지 들어왔다.\" —: "Broke through twelve interceptor drones. The Warzone's within sight now." — Sona
\"격파 열 번. 예고는 제때 할게.\" — 소나: "Ten clears. I'll get the warnings out on time." — Sona
\"열 번. 예상과 결과의 차이를 적기 시작했다.\" — 소나: "Ten. I've started logging the gap between forecast and result." — Sona
\"격전지 잔해장. 합금이 많이 들어와 — 상한 확인해. 흘리면 아깝잖아: "Old Warzone Wreckfield. Lots of alloy coming in — check the cap. Spilling it would be such a waste." — Saga
\"격전지의 잔해를 처음 밟았다. 스코프 다음 칸은 광맥이다.\" — 소: "First step onto the Warzone wreckage. Next square on the scope is the ore vein." — Sona
\"광맥 소행성이나 침묵의 중계기. 통제실 5 다음 항로야.\" — 소나: "Ore-Vein Asteroid or Silent Relay. The route after Control Room 5." — Sona
\"다섯 번째 항로가 열린 뒤 첫 격파. 광맥은 합금, 중계기는 부품 —: "First clear since the fifth route opened. The vein gives Alloy, the relay gives Parts — either way, the depot changes." — Sona
\"폐기된 조선소. 부품 설계도가 남아 있대.\" — 테스라: "Abandoned Shipyard. Parts schematics: reportedly still there." — Tesla
\"자율 방위 체계가 꺼졌다. 보이는 데 남은 설계도는 기함의 것이다.\: "The autonomous defense system went dark. The blueprint left in sight belongs to the flagship." — Sona
\"심우주 관측소. 소나의 범위 끝, 내 표의 끝.\" — 아스트라: "Deep-Space Observatory. End of Sona's range. End of my table." — Astra
\"관측소가 조용해졌다. 그 너머 회랑까지 보이기 시작한다.\" — 소나: "The observatory went quiet. The corridor beyond it is starting to come into view." — Sona
\"함대인 줄 알았다. 전파가… 잡히다 말다 해.\" — 사일런: "Thought it was a fleet. The signal… keeps cutting in and out." — Silen
\"신호 없는 배 한 척을 격파했다. 코어가 가장 많이 나오는 곳이다.\: "Cleared a ship with no signal. It's where the most Core comes from." — Sona
\"심연 뺀 열한 곳. 범위 안은 다 봤다고 말할 수 있게.\" — 소나: "Eleven sites, not counting the Abyss. So I can say I've seen everything in range." — Sona
\"전장 지도의 좌표를 다 밟았다. 보이는 데까지는 이제 내 지도다.\": "Every coordinate on the battlefield map, walked. As far as I can see, the map's mine now." — Sona
\"스물다섯 번쯤이면 항로가 눈에 익는다.\" — 소나: "Around twenty-five times, the routes start to look familiar." — Sona
\"스물다섯 번 보내고 스물다섯 번 받았다. 그게 관측의 전부다.\" —: "Sent them out twenty-five times, got them back twenty-five times. That's all observing is." — Sona
\"좌표 넷을 채우면 지도가 지도처럼 보인다.\" — 소나: "Fill four coordinates and the map starts looking like a map." — Sona
\"네 좌표. 이제 어디가 비었는지가 보인다.\" — 소나: "Four coordinates. Now I can see where the gaps are." — Sona
\"좌표 여섯. 지도의 빈칸이 절반 아래로 줄어.\" — 소나: "Six coordinates. The blanks on the map drop below half." — Sona
\"여섯 좌표. 없는 걸로 친 범위 밖이 오히려 더 궁금해진다.\" —: "Six coordinates. What's out of range counts as nothing — which makes me more curious about it." — Sona
\"좌표 여덟. 남은 건 이름만 들은 곳, 아직 없는 걸로.\" — 소나: "Eight coordinates. What's left are places I only know by name. Those don't count yet." — Sona
\"여덟 좌표. 항로표 가장자리까지 발자국이 닿았다.\" — 소나: "Eight coordinates. The footprints reach the edge of the route chart." — Sona
\"격파 쉰 번. 복기할 게 쌓였어.\" — 미네르바: "Fifty clears. The debrief material has piled up." — Minerva
\"쉰 번. 예상이 빗나간 날은 손으로 꼽는다.\" — 소나: "Fifty. I can count the days the forecast missed on my fingers." — Sona
\"백 번을 보내면 돌아오는 점만 봐도 누군지 안다.\" — 소나: "Send them out a hundred times and you know who it is just from the dot coming back." — Sona
\"백 번. 스코프에 겹친 항적이 이제 길로 보인다.\" — 소나: "A hundred. The wakes overlapping on the scope look like a road now." — Sona
\"격파 백오십. 레이더에 뜬 귀환 점을 세다 잠든 적도 있어.\" —: "A hundred and fifty clears. I've fallen asleep counting return dots on the radar." — Sona
\"백오십 번. 돌아오는 순서까지 외워 버렸다.\" — 소나: "A hundred and fifty. I've memorized even the order they come back in." — Sona
\"격파 이백 번. 그쯤이면 보는 내가 배워.\" — 소나: "Two hundred clears. By then, I'm the one watching and learning." — Sona
\"이백 번. 레이더는 이제 내 눈이 아니라 습관이다.\" — 소나: "Two hundred. The radar isn't my eyes anymore. It's a habit." — Sona
\"격파 삼백. 돌아오는 점마다 버릇이 보인다는 걸 알게 될 거야.\": "Three hundred clears. You'll find you can see habits in every returning dot." — Sona
\"삼백 번. 점 하나만 보고도 누가 먼저 오는지 안다.\" — 소나: "Three hundred. I know who's coming first from a single dot." — Sona
\"격파 오백. 그쯤이면 레이더 안쪽이 길이 아니라 동네야.\" — 소나: "Five hundred clears. By then the inside of the radar isn't roads. It's the neighborhood." — Sona
\"오백 번. 레이더가 우리 신호를 먼저 알아본다.\" — 소나: "Five hundred. The radar recognizes our signal first." — Sona
\"격파 천 번. 보이는 건 내가 다 셀게.\" — 소나: "A thousand clears. Whatever I can see, I'll count." — Sona
\"천 번. 보이는 걸 세다 그만둘 줄 알았는데, 끝까지 셌다.\" —: "A thousand. I thought I'd quit counting what I could see partway. I counted to the end." — Sona
\"출격지는 재고가 바닥나면 다음 세대로 바뀌어. 더 세지고 더 많이 줘: "When a sortie site's stock runs dry, it turns over to the next generation. Tougher, and it gives more." — Sona
\"두 번째 세대. 예전 좌표는 없는 걸로, 이름은 그대로.\" — 소나: "Second generation. The old coordinates count as gone; the name didn't change." — Sona
\"3세대 출격지. 멀어 — 냄새 나도 연료 채워 둘게.\" — 나프타: "Gen 3 sortie site. It's far — I'll top up the fuel, smell and all." — Naphtha
\"두 번 다시 나타난 곳을 또 격파했다. 적은 ×1.50 이었다.\": "Cleared again a place that had come back twice. The defenders were ×1.50." — Sona
\"5세대부터는 이름만 같은 다른 곳이야.\" — 소나: "From Gen 5 on, it's a different place with the same name." — Sona
\"다섯 번째 세대. 처음 그 좌표를 찍었던 날이 레이더 끝보다 멀다.\: "Fifth generation. The day I first marked that coordinate is farther than the radar's edge." — Sona
\"6세대. 지도에 적힌 이름보다 우리가 붙인 이름이 더 오래됐어.\": "Gen 6. The names we gave are older than the ones written on the map." — Sona
\"여섯 번째 세대. 같은 이름이 여섯 번 다른 자리에서 태어나는 걸 봤: "Sixth generation. I've watched the same name be born in six different places." — Sona
\"다른 모함의 사격 기록도 받아 두고 있다. 벽은 여기만이 아니다.\": "We're keeping other motherships' firing logs too. This isn't the only wall." — Ballista
\"모든 벽의 기록이 한 장 찼다. 벽은 여기만이 아니었다.\" — 발리: "Every wall's records filled a page. This was never the only wall." — Ballista
\"방어력 300. 우리 셋의 첫 벽이다.\" — 발리스타: "Defense 300. The first wall for the three of us." — Ballista
\"삼백. 첫 습격은 이 숫자를 시험하러 온다.\" — 발리스타: "Three hundred. The first raid will come to test that number." — Ballista
\"대공 기관포 Lv.1. 언니, 군집은 내가 맡을게!\" — 플뢰르: "AA Gun Lv.1. Sis, swarms are mine!" — Fleur
\"플뢰르의 대공포. 드론 떼는 이제 둘째 몫이다.\" — 발리스타: "Fleur's AA gun. Drone swarms are the second sister's now." — Ballista
\"첫 격퇴. 벽이 서 있으면 온다.\" — 발리스타: "First repulse. Stand up a wall and they come." — Ballista
\"포탑이 처음 일했다. 다음은 더 크게 온다.\" — 발리스타: "The turret did its first work. The next one comes bigger." — Ballista
\"방어력 1,000. 평균 습격은 여기서 멈춰 — 큰 놈은 내 몫이거든: "Defense power 1,000. An average raid stops here — the big ones are mine, you know." — Volta
\"천. 평균 규모 습격은 이제 이 벽을 못 넘는다 — 큰 놈은 온다.\: "A thousand. An average raid can't get over this wall now — the big ones still come." — Ballista
\"레일건 포대 Lv.1. 막내 아니야, 포대장이야.\" — 볼타: "Railgun Battery Lv.1. I'm not the baby. I'm the Battery Chief." — Volta
\"볼타의 레일건. 중장 돌파는 이제 셋째가 상대한다.\" — 발리스타: "Volta's railgun. Heavy breakthroughs are the third sister's to handle now." — Ballista
\"요격 레이저 Lv.1. 약탈해 오면, 돌아가는 길까지 빛을 쏠게요.\: "Interceptor Laser Lv.1. If they come to plunder, I will keep my light on them even on their way back." — Lumen
\"네 번째 포문. 이제 막내는 내가 아니야.\" — 볼타: "Fourth gunport. I'm not the baby anymore." — Volta
\"격퇴 열 번. 우리 셋의 사격 기록이 한 장 찬다.\" — 발리스타: "Ten repulses. That fills a page of the firing log for the three of us." — Ballista
\"열 번. 둘째의 대공, 셋째의 레일건. 각자의 상대를 기억한다.\": "Ten. Our second's AA, our third's railgun. Each remembers its own targets." — Ballista
\"스물다섯 번이면 세 포신이 제자리를 기억한다.\" — 발리스타: "At twenty-five, all three barrels remember their positions." — Ballista
\"스물다섯 번. 이제 경보가 울려도 셋 다 손이 먼저 움직인다.\" —: "Twenty-five. Now when the alarm sounds, all three of us move our hands first." — Ballista
\"한 겹으로는 오래 못 버틴다.\" — 발리스타: "One layer won't hold for long." — Ballista
\"육백. 한 겹이 뚫려도 뒤가 남는다.\" — 발리스타: "Six hundred. If one layer breaks, there's still one behind it." — Ballista
\"격퇴 쉰 번. 습격 유형 복기가 끝난다.\" — 미네르바: "Fifty repulses. Debrief of raid types: complete." — Minerva
\"쉰 번. 포격 지휘관이 아니라 요새 관리인이 된 기분이다.\" — 발: "Fifty. I feel less like a gunnery commander and more like a fortress caretaker." — Ballista
\"일흔다섯 번. 언니, 습격 부대가 우리 사거리를 외웠을 거야.\" —: "Seventy-five! Sis, I bet the raiders know our range by heart by now." — Fleur
\"일흔다섯. 경보 소리가 이제 우리 셋의 박자처럼 들린다.\" — 발리: "Seventy-five. The alarm sounds like the beat the three of us keep now." — Ballista
\"백 번. 우리 셋은 습격의 시간표를 안다.\" — 발리스타: "A hundred. The three of us know the raids' timetable." — Ballista
\"백 번. 경보가 울리기 전에 우리 포신 셋이 먼저 돈다.\" — 발리: "A hundred. Our three barrels turn before the alarm sounds." — Ballista
\"격퇴 이백 번. 벽이 아니라 요새다.\" — 발리스타: "Two hundred repulses. Not a wall — a fortress." — Ballista
\"이백 번. 네 칸짜리 사격 기록이 한 권이 됐다.\" — 발리스타: "Two hundred. The four-column firing log has become a whole volume." — Ballista
\"약탈로 처음 방어를 넘으면 기록에 남는다.\" — 발리스타: "Your first plunder past their defenses goes on record." — Ballista
\"남의 포탑을 뚫었다. 우리 포탑도 언젠가 뚫린다는 뜻이다.\" — 발: "We broke through someone's turrets. That means ours will be broken someday too." — Ballista
\"돌파 세 번. 한 번은 운, 세 번은 실력이다.\" — 발리스타: "Three breaches. Once is luck; three times is skill." — Ballista
\"세 번. 우리 셋 다 상대 방벽의 틈을 보는 눈이 생겼다.\" — 발: "Three. All three of us have an eye for the gaps in their walls now." — Ballista
\"돌파 열 번. 값 안 치른 물건은 장부에 안 적어요.\" — 마르셰: "Ten breaches. Goods that were not paid for do not go in my ledger." — Marché
\"열 번. 상대들이 당직을 늘리기 시작했다.\" — 발리스타: "Ten. Our targets have started adding to their watch." — Ballista
\"탐지 범위 밖에서 출발하면 당직만 맞선다. 전파는 내가 꺼 둘게.\": "Launch from outside detection range, and only the watch meets you… I'll keep the radio off." — Silen
\"당직만 나온 집을 뚫었다. 레이더 밖에서 출발한 게 답이었다.\" —: "We broke into a home where only the watch came out. Launching from outside their radar was the answer." — Ballista
\"6라운드를 버틴 벽을 일부라도 넘으면 기록한다.\" — 발리스타: "Get even partly past a wall that held 6 rounds, and it goes on record." — Ballista
\"다 못 죽였지만 뚫린 걸로 친다. 다음엔 한 라운드 더 간다.\" —: "We didn't finish them all, but it counts as a breach. Next time, we go one more round." — Ballista
\"맞았으면 되갚을 수 있어. 언니가 먼저 나서겠지만.\" — 플뢰르: "If we got hit, we can hit back. Though my sister will go first." — Fleur
\"우리를 친 손을 돌려줬다. 보복권은 한 번뿐이라 더 달다.\" — 발: "We struck back at the hand that hit us. Revenge rights only come once, so it's sweeter." — Ballista
\"세 번! 되갚을 때마다 먼저 치는 쪽이 망설여.\" — 플뢰르: "Three! Each time we hit back, whoever strikes first hesitates." — Fleur
\"세 번. 보복권이 경고장이 되었다.\" — 발리스타: "Three. Our revenge rights have become a warning letter." — Ballista
\"지휘관의 약탈을 격퇴하시면, 금고는 그날 잠겨 있을 것입니다.\" —: "If you repel a commander's plunder, the vault shall remain locked that day." — Berta
\"사람의 편성을 되돌려 보냈다. 기록에 「원인 불명의 명중률 저하」라: "We sent a commander's squad back. Their log will read 'accuracy drop, cause unknown.'" — Ballista
\"세 번 막으면 그 집은 소문이 납니다. 건드리면 손해라고.\" — 베: "Hold them off three times and word gets around about that home. That it does not pay to touch it." — Berta
\"세 번. 금고 문 두드리던 소리, 우리 셋이 줄였다.\" — 발리스타: "Three. The knocking at the vault door — the three of us cut it down." — Ballista
\"열 번 막은 집은 지도에서 피해 갑니다. 보이지 않는 것처럼.\" —: "A home that has held ten times is one they steer around on the map. As though it could not be seen." — Berta
\"열 번. 약탈 편성이 우리 좌표를 지나쳐 간다.\" — 발리스타: "Ten. Plunder squads pass right by our coordinates." — Ballista
\"탐지 범위 밖에서 오면 당직만 맞서. 장갑 두꺼운 순이야.\" — 노: "If they come from outside detection range, only the watch meets them. Thickest armor first." — Nova
\"당직만으로 막았어. 오늘 밤 당번들한테 한 잔 돌려.\" — 노바: "The watch held on its own. Buy them a round tonight." — Nova
\"격벽 Lv.1. 이 선 안쪽이 배야.\" — 파비스: "Bulkhead Lv.1. Inside this line is the ship." — Pavise
\"파비스가 분필 선 하나 그었을 뿐인데, 다들 그 안쪽에 서.\" —: "Pavise only drew one chalk line, and everyone stands inside it." — Harpa
\"깎인 판은 버리지 마. 날짜를 적어야 하니까.\" — 파비스: "Don't throw out the worn plates. They need dates written on them." — Pavise
\"벽에 걸린 판이 늘수록, 도크에 오는 애들이 줄었어.\" — 리벳: "More plates on the wall, fewer girls coming to the dock." — Rivet
\"엔진 Lv.1. 그을음 묻힌 만큼 배가 조금 더 빨리 흘러가.\" —: "Engine Lv.1. Soot earned, and the ship drifts a bit faster." — Bella
\"빨라진 만큼 장부가 길어졌어. 괜찮아, 그 줄은 비워 뒀으니까.\": "Faster means a longer ledger. It's fine — I left that line blank." — Nova
\"경유지 삼백 곳. 계기판 숫자가 한 줄 줄었잖아.\" — 벨라: "Three hundred waypoints. The gauge readout's one line shorter, see?" — Bella
\"전장이 넓어도 이제 하루에 몇 바퀴는 돌고 오지.\" — 노바: "Wide as the battlefield is, we make a few laps a day and come back now." — Nova
\"뚫려도 끝난 게 아니에요. 도망치는 배는 제 빛이 쫓아요.\" — 루: "A breach is not the end. My light will chase the ships that run." — Lumen
\"다 가져가진 못했어요. 반쯤은 제가 떨궜거든요.\" — 루멘: "They could not take it all. I knocked about half of it loose." — Lumen
\"함대전 첫 승. 투영끼리라도 이기는 건 이기는 거다.\" — 발리스타: "First Fleet War win. Projection against projection, a win is still a win." — Ballista
\"첫 승. 우리 모함의 투영이 남의 투영을 이겼다 — 원본은 더 강하다: "First win. Our Mothership's projection beat someone else's — and the original is stronger." — Ballista
\"함대전 다섯 승. 대진표에 우리 이름이 굵어진다.\" — 발리스타: "Five Fleet War wins. Our name gets bolder on the bracket." — Ballista
\"다섯 번. 상대가 우리 편성을 보고 오기 시작했다.\" — 발리스타: "Five. Opponents have started coming in having studied our squads." — Ballista
\"함대전 열 승. 두 자릿수부터는 운 아니거든.\" — 볼타: "Ten Fleet War wins. Double digits isn't luck, you know." — Volta
\"열 번. 대진표에서 우리 이름을 먼저 찾는 모함이 생겼다.\" — 발: "Ten. Some motherships look for our name on the bracket first." — Ballista
\"열다섯 승. 리그가 우리를 기억하게 된다.\" — 발리스타: "Fifteen wins. The league will remember us." — Ballista
\"열다섯. 이 기록은 투영이 아니라 지휘관의 것이다.\" — 발리스타: "Fifteen. This record isn't the projection's. It's the Commander's." — Ballista
\"서른 승. 포대 기록판 한 장이 차거든.\" — 볼타: "Thirty wins. That's one full page of the battery record board, just so you know." — Volta
\"서른. 기록판 새로 거는 건 내가 해.\" — 볼타: "Thirty. I'm the one hanging up the new record board." — Volta
\"예순 승. 대진표를 넘기는 손이 빨라진다.\" — 볼타: "Sixty wins. My hands flip through the bracket faster." — Volta
\"예순. 상대 이름보다 우리 이름을 먼저 찾게 됐다.\" — 볼타: "Sixty. Now I look for our name before the other side's." — Volta
\"백 승. 포신 하나 갈아 끼울 때가 된다니까.\" — 볼타: "A hundred wins. Time to swap out a barrel — told you." — Volta
\"백. 포신은 갈아도 기록은 안 지워. 절대.\" — 볼타: "A hundred. Swap the barrel, sure, but I'm not erasing the record. Never." — Volta
\"이백 승. 리그가 한 바퀴 돌아도 남는 숫자다.\" — 볼타: "Two hundred wins. A number that sticks even after the league comes around again." — Volta
\"이백이라고. 이제 이 숫자가 우리 이름이야.\" — 볼타: "Two hundred, I'm telling you. This number's our name now." — Volta
\"열세라고 적힌 판, 이겨 보면 알거든. 판세는 예보일 뿐이야.\" —: "Win a match marked 'underdog' and you'll know. The odds are just a forecast." — Volta
\"열세였다. 이겼다. 예보를 고칠 필요는 없다 — 우리가 고쳤으니.\": "We were the underdog. We won. No need to fix the forecast — we already did." — Volta
\"1부 판에서 한 번. 가장 센 열 척 사이에서.\" — 볼타: "Once in a Div. 1 match. Among the ten strongest ships." — Volta
\"1부에서 이겼다. 거 봐, 위에는 이제 없어.\" — 볼타: "Won in Div. 1. Told you — there's nothing above now." — Volta
\"1부에서 다섯 승. 강한 판에서 이겨야 진짜거든.\" — 볼타: "Five wins in Div. 1. Winning the tough matches is the real thing, you know." — Volta
\"다섯 번. 1부 대진표가 우리 셋에게 낯설지 않다.\" — 발리스타: "Five. The Div. 1 bracket doesn't feel strange to the three of us anymore." — Ballista
\"1부에서 열다섯 승. 리그가 네 이름으로 기억돼.\" — 볼타: "Fifteen wins in Div. 1. The league remembers your name." — Volta
\"열다섯. 1부의 포성 절반은 우리 것이다.\" — 발리스타: "Fifteen. Half the gunfire in Div. 1 is ours." — Ballista
\"표류 모함 없이 열 척 모두 지휘관인 판. 드물게 열리거든.\" —: "A match with no drifting ships — all ten are commanders. Those don't open often, you know." — Volta
\"열 척 모두 사람이었다. 그래서 더 시끄러웠다.\" — 볼타: "All ten ships were people. That's why it was louder." — Volta
\"이긴 판에서 가장 많이 쏜 모함이 기함이거든.\" — 볼타: "In a match you win, the Mothership that fired the most is the flagship. That's just how it is." — Volta
\"오늘의 기함. 봐, 다섯 척이 우리 포성을 따라왔잖아.\" — 볼타: "Today's flagship. See? Five ships followed our guns." — Volta
\"기함 세 번. 편성이 우리 포성을 기다린다.\" — 볼타: "Flagship three times. The squad waits for our guns." — Volta
\"세 번. 다섯 척 중 제일 먼저 포문 연 거, 나야.\" — 볼타: "Three. First of the five to open fire? That was me." — Volta
\"기함 열 번. 그 자리는 이제 네 거야.\" — 볼타: "Flagship ten times. That seat's yours now." — Volta
\"열 번. 대진이 발표되면 모두 우리 모함부터 본다.\" — 볼타: "Ten. When the bracket goes up, everyone looks at our Mothership first." — Volta
\"거함은 혼자 못 잡아. 그래도 제 몫은 혼자 하거든.\" — 볼타: "No one takes down a Dreadnought alone. But your own share, you do alone. Just so you know." — Volta
\"첫 거함. 열 척 포성 속에 우리 것도 있었다니까.\" — 볼타: "First Dreadnought. Told you — ours was in the roar of ten ships' guns too." — Volta
\"블랙 비컨. 불 꺼진 등대를 찾는 배는 없다 — 우리 말고는.\" —: "Black Beacon. No ship goes looking for a lighthouse with its light out — except us." — Sona
\"비컨이 꺼졌다. 다음 신호는 요람 쪽에서 보일 거다.\" — 소나: "The Beacon went dark. The next signal will show up from the cradle's side." — Sona
\"그레이브키퍼. 부서진 배를 끝없이 고치는 배를 넘어야 붉은 요새가 보: "Gravekeeper. Get past the ship that endlessly repairs broken ships, and the red fortress comes into view." — Sona
\"묘지기를 지났다. 보이는 끝에 붉은 요새가 떠 있다.\" — 소나: "Past the Gravekeeper. At the edge of what I can see, a red fortress floats." — Sona
\"발타자르. 스코프로 보면 주포 하나에 선체를 붙인 거함이다. 한 발이: "Balthazar. Through the scope, it's one main gun with a hull bolted on. Every shot hits hard." — Sona
\"발타자르의 주포가 식었다. 스코프엔 끝나지 않는 행렬만 남았다.\": "Balthazar's main gun has cooled. Only the endless march is left on the scope." — Sona
\"슬리핑 퀸. 함교에만 불이 켜져 있다 — 누가 깨어 있는 걸까.\": "Sleeping Queen. Only the bridge has its lights on — who's awake in there?" — Sona
"The lights on the Queen's bridge went out. The ship they all escorted, Ark Zero, is in sight." — Sona
\"아크 제로. 모든 유령 거함이 호위하던 배. 그 너머는 고쳐 띄운 배: "Ark Zero. The ship every Ghost Dreadnought escorted. Past it, there are only ships patched up and set afloat again." — Sona
\"제로를 넘었다. 이제 돌아오는 배들은 모두 改를 달고 온다.\" —: "Past Zero. Every ship that comes back now comes wearing 改." — Sona
\"거함이 기울 때 마지막 포탄이 누구 건지 다 기록되거든.\" — 볼타: "When a Dreadnought tips over, the record shows exactly whose shell was last, you know." — Volta
\"마지막 한 발. 기록판에 우리 이름이 맨 아래 — 가장 늦게, 가장: "The last shot. Our name's at the very bottom of the board — last, and biggest." — Volta
\"편대의 앞에 서는 배는 하나다.\" — 볼타: "Only one ship stands at the front of the squadron." — Volta
\"선봉. 아홉 척이 우리 뒤에서 쐈다.\" — 볼타: "Vanguard. Nine ships fired from behind us." — Volta
\"놓친 배는 밤새 고치지 못한다. 깎은 만큼 다음 날로 이어진다.\": "A ship that got away can't repair overnight. Whatever we chipped off carries into the next day." — Volta
\"이틀째에 잡았다. 도망친 배는 흔적을 남긴다.\" — 볼타: "Got it on day two. A ship that runs leaves a trail." — Volta
\"열 척 중 한 척이 5분의 1을 쏘면, 그 포격은 그 배 거거든.\": "If one ship in ten fires 1/5 of the shots, that bombardment belongs to that ship. I'm telling you." — Volta
\"그 포격은 우리 것이었다. 나머지 아홉 척도 안다.\" — 볼타: "That bombardment was ours. The other nine ships know it too." — Volta
\"혼자 떠도는 모함보다, 같은 깃발 아래가 오래 가는 법이지.\" —: "Under one flag, you last longer than drifting alone. That's how it goes." — Nova
\"깃발이 하나 늘었어. 이제 우리끼리는 서로 털지 않아.\" — 노바: "One more flag. Now we don't rob our own." — Nova
\"깃발은 누군가 먼저 올리는 거지.\" — 노바: "Someone always raises the flag first." — Nova
\"네 이름으로 깃발이 섰어. 오는 사람을 받는 것도 이제 네 몫이야.\: "A flag's up in your name. Taking in whoever comes is your job now." — Nova
\"연합이 커지면 혼자선 못 챙겨. 믿을 사람이 필요하지.\" — 노바: "When an Alliance grows, one person can't keep up. You need someone you trust." — Nova
\"오른팔이 됐어. 신청서가 네 책상에도 쌓이기 시작할 거야.\" — 노: "You're the right hand now. Applications will start piling up on your desk too." — Nova
\"연합 거함은 혼자 못 잡아. 모두가 제 몫을 한 날 넘어간다.\" —: "No one takes down an Alliance Dreadnought alone. It goes down on the day everyone does their share." — Volta
\"같이 쏘니까 넘어가더라. 오늘은 연합 전부가 선봉이야.\" — 볼타: "We fired together and down it went. Today the whole Alliance is the vanguard." — Volta
\"성채는 연합이 같이 서는 자리야. 다섯 척에 들면 기록해 둘게.\": "The Citadel is where the Alliance stands together. Make the five-ship lineup and I'll log it." — Volta
\"첫 출전. 성벽 앞 기록판에 우리 연합 줄이 생겼다.\" — 볼타: "First deployment. Our Alliance got a line on the board before the walls." — Volta
\"열 판이면 성채 둘레쯤은 외우거든.\" — 볼타: "Ten matches and you've got the Citadel Perimeter memorized, you know." — Volta
\"열. 성벽 어디가 먼저 깨지는지 이제 나도 알거든.\" — 볼타: "Ten. Now I know which part of the wall cracks first, too." — Volta
\"서른 판. 이기든 지든 다섯 척에 들었다는 뜻이야.\" — 볼타: "Thirty matches. Win or lose, it means you made the five ships." — Volta
\"서른. 연합 다섯 척 자리에 늘 이름이 있었다.\" — 볼타: "Thirty. Our name was always in the Alliance's five slots." — Volta
\"백 판. 성채가 바뀌는 걸 몇 번이나 봤을까.\" — 볼타: "A hundred matches. How many times have I watched the Citadel change hands?" — Volta
\"백. 성채 기록판 절반이 우리 연합 글씨다.\" — 볼타: "A hundred. Half the Citadel board is in our Alliance's handwriting." — Volta
\"남이 쥔 성채를 넘으면 그 판은 우리 이름이거든.\" — 볼타: "Take a Citadel someone else holds, and that match has our name on it. Just so you know." — Volta
\"넘었다니까. 깃발 바꿔 다는 데 한 판 걸렸어.\" — 볼타: "Told you we made it over. Changing the flag took one match." — Volta
\"다섯 번 깃발을 바꾸면, 상대도 우리 이름을 외워.\" — 볼타: "Change the flag five times and the other side learns our name too." — Volta
\"다섯 번이라니까. 깃발 매듭쯤은 손에 익었어.\" — 볼타: "Five times, told you. My hands know a flag knot by now." — Volta
\"스무 번. 성채는 원래 우리 자리였던 것처럼.\" — 볼타: "Twenty. Like the Citadel was ours all along." — Volta
\"스물. 함락 기록은 따로 한 권 묶었어. 내가 했다고.\" — 볼타: "Twenty. Bound a separate book just for the falls. I did that." — Volta
\"쥔 성채를 지켜 내는 것도 점령이야.\" — 볼타: "Holding on to a Citadel you've taken counts as conquest too." — Volta
\"막았다니까. 성벽에 새 탄흔만 늘었어.\" — 볼타: "Held, I told you. Only new scars on the walls." — Volta
\"열 번 막으면 성벽이 우리 편 되거든.\" — 볼타: "Hold ten times and the walls are on our side, you know." — Volta
\"열 번이면, 거 봐. 도전하는 쪽이 먼저 망설이잖아.\" — 볼타: "Ten, and see? Told you. The challengers hesitate first." — Volta
\"서른 번. 그쯤이면 성채가 이름을 기억해.\" — 볼타: "Thirty. By then the Citadel remembers your name." — Volta
\"서른. 성벽 수리 기록이 공격 기록보다 길다.\" — 볼타: "Thirty. The wall repair log is longer than the attack log." — Volta
"Overlaying the markers from every route chart. One in four. Every time. Everyone's." — Astra
\"표식이 별자리가 됐다. 한 사람의 항로표엔 없던 그림.\" — 아스트: "The markers became a constellation. A picture no single route chart had." — Astra
\"경유지 사건 열 개. 표식은 쌓여. 매번.\" — 아스트라: "Ten waypoint events. The markers add up. Every time." — Astra
\"열 개. 여백 한 줄 부족. 처음이야.\" — 아스트라: "Ten. One line short in the margin. A first." — Astra
\"표식 스물. 같은 좌표, 두 번 멈췄어.\" — 아스트라: "Twenty markers. Same coordinate, stopped twice." — Astra
\"첫 경유지 사건. 항로에 표식 하나 — 돌아오는 길에 보이겠지.\": "First waypoint event. A marker on the route — you'll see it on the way back." — Nova
\"경유지에서 무언가를 주웠다. 표식 하나. 매번 남긴다.\" — 아스트: "Picked something up at a waypoint. One marker. I leave one every time." — Astra
\"사건 서른 개. 항로표에 별자리.\" — 아스트라: "Thirty events. A constellation on the route chart." — Astra
\"표식 서른. 지도는 이제 항로표 말고 일지.\" — 아스트라: "Thirty markers. The map's a log now, not a route chart." — Astra
\"표식 마흔. 우연도 매번 반복되면 항로야.\" — 아스트라: "Forty markers. Chance repeated every time is a route." — Astra
\"마흔 개. 표식 사이, 선. 그어도 되겠어.\" — 아스트라: "Forty. Lines between the markers. Safe to draw now." — Astra
\"대박(×3). 어떤 환율보다 남는 장사네요.\" — 마르셰: "A Big Score (×3). That is more profit than any rate brings, I dare say." — Marché
\"세 배. 먼 구역일수록 자주 온다더니.\" — 아스트라: "Three times over. They said it comes more often the farther out you go." — Astra
\"폭풍 구역 사건은 보상이 두 배를 넘어. 연료만 챙겨.\" — 아스트: "Storm zone events pay more than double. Just bring fuel." — Astra
\"폭풍 속 표식. 레이더는 흔들려도 좌표는 남아. 매번.\" — 아스트: "A marker in the storm. The radar shakes; the coordinates stay. Every time." — Astra
\"폭풍 구역 사건 열 번. 그 항로는 너만 알아.\" — 아스트라: "Ten storm zone events. Only you know that route." — Astra
\"열 번. 폭풍 구역 한가운데, 우리만 아는 표식. 매번 늘어.\" —: "Ten. Middle of the storm zone, markers only we know. More every time." — Astra
\"폭풍 구역 사건 스물다섯. 바람 꺾이는 좌표, 표에 올렸어.\" —: "Twenty-five storm zone events. Coordinates where the wind bends: on the chart." — Astra
\"스물다섯 번. 폭풍 한가운데에도 길. 매번 있었다.\" — 아스트라: "Twenty-five. Even in the heart of the storm, a road. There was one every time." — Astra
\"폭풍 구역 사건 쉰. 폭풍이 우리를 알아볼지도 몰라.\" — 아스트라: "Fifty storm zone events. The storm might start to recognize us." — Astra
\"쉰 번. 폭풍은 그대로. 바뀐 건 우리 쪽.\" — 아스트라: "Fifty. The storm: unchanged. What changed was us." — Astra
\"잭팟(×10). 표에 없는 좌표.\" — 아스트라: "Jackpot (×10). A coordinate not on the table." — Astra
\"열 배. 먼 구역에서도 드물어. 다음, 한참 뒤.\" — 아스트라: "Ten times over. Rare even far out. Next: a long way off." — Astra
\"대박 열 번. 운도 쌓이면 실력처럼 보여요. 장사도 그렇고요.\" —: "Ten Big Scores. Luck, once it piles up, starts to look like skill. The same goes for trade." — Marché
\"열 번. 확률표는 맞았어. 매번 많이 갔을 뿐.\" — 아스트라: "Ten. The odds table was right. We just went a lot, every time." — Astra
\"대박 스물다섯. 장부에 이윤 칸을 따로 만들어 둘게요.\" — 마르셰: "Twenty-five Big Scores. I will make a separate profit column in the ledger." — Marché
\"스물다섯 번. 마르셰가 대박 칸을 새로 그었다.\" — 아스트라: "Twenty-five. Marché ruled a new column for big scores." — Astra
\"잭팟 세 번. 표에 없는 좌표가 세 개면 그건 표가 틀린 거야.\": "Three jackpots. Three coordinates not on the table means the table's wrong." — Astra
\"세 번. 표에 없는 좌표 셋을 표에 적었다.\" — 아스트라: "Three. Wrote the three missing coordinates into the table." — Astra
\"심연 회랑 티어 1. 첫 고리는 시뮬레이터로 먼저. 실전은 그다음.\: "Abyss Corridor tier 1. The first ring goes through the simulator first. Live fire after that." — Minerva
\"끝없는 원정의 첫 고리. 끝이 없다는 건 아직 소문이다.\" — 아스: "First ring of the endless expedition. 'Endless' is still a rumor." — Astra
\"회랑 두 번째 고리. 첫 고리는 입구. 그뿐.\" — 아스트라: "Corridor, second ring. The first ring: the entrance. That's all." — Astra
\"두 번째 고리. 안쪽 좌표, 흐려지기 시작.\" — 아스트라: "Second ring. Inner coordinates, starting to blur." — Astra
\"표식 쉰 개. 항로표 두께가 달라져.\" — 아스트라: "Fifty markers. The route chart's thickness changes." — Astra
\"쉰 개. 우연이라기엔 많아. 매번이니까.\" — 아스트라: "Fifty. Too many to call chance. It's every time." — Astra
\"일흔다섯. 넷에 하나꼴이 이렇게 쌓이면 법칙처럼 보여.\" — 아스트: "Seventy-five. One in four, stacked this high, starts to look like a law." — Astra
\"표식 백 개. 별자리 하나, 새로.\" — 아스트라: "A hundred markers. One new constellation." — Astra
\"백 개의 표식. 내 항로표에만 있는 별자리가 생겼다.\" — 아스트라: "A hundred markers. A constellation that's only on my route chart." — Astra
\"표식 백오십. 별자리 둘, 이어지기 시작.\" — 아스트라: "A hundred and fifty markers. Two constellations, starting to connect." — Astra
\"백오십 개. 두 별자리가 한 줄로 이어졌다.\" — 아스트라: "A hundred and fifty. Two constellations joined in one line." — Astra
\"표식 이백. 그쯤이면 항로표가 하늘을 닮아.\" — 아스트라: "Two hundred markers. By then, the route chart looks like the sky." — Astra
\"이백 개. 항로표를 펼치면 매번 밤하늘.\" — 아스트라: "Two hundred. Unfold the route chart and it's a night sky, every time." — Astra
\"표식 삼백. 내 표기가 남의 항로표에도 옮겨 가겠지.\" — 아스트라: "Three hundred markers. My notation will probably spread to other people's route charts." — Astra
\"삼백 개. 이 하늘, 전부 우리 손글씨.\" — 아스트라: "Three hundred. This sky — all our handwriting." — Astra
\"세 번째 고리부터. 회랑이 좁아져.\" — 아스트라: "From the third ring. The Corridor narrows." — Astra
\"셋. 여기부터는 탐조등을 켜고 들어간다.\" — 아스트라: "Three. From here, we go in with the searchlights on." — Astra
\"티어 5. 고리는 안으로 갈수록 좁다.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 5. The rings get narrower the farther in." — Astra
\"티어 7. 여기서부터는 귀환 좌표도 계산해.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 7. From here on, the return coordinates get calculated too." — Astra
\"고리 일곱. 회랑 벽 좌표, 처음 보는 표기.\" — 아스트라: "Seven rings. Corridor wall coordinates: notation never seen before." — Astra
\"티어 10. 편성 연료는 가득 채워 둘게. 냄새는 미안.\" — 나프: "Tier 10. I'll fill the squads' fuel to the brim. Sorry about the smell." — Naphtha
\"티어 15. 내 항로표에 없는 좌표.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 15. Coordinates not on my route chart." — Astra
\"고리 열다섯. 회랑 끝, 아직 못 찾음.\" — 아스트라: "Fifteen rings. The Corridor's end: not found yet." — Astra
\"티어 20. 귀환 좌표는 내가 계산해 둘게.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 20. I'll have the return coordinates calculated." — Astra
\"스무 번째 고리. 회랑 벽의 표기가 우리 별자리 표기와 같다.\" —: "Twentieth ring. The notation on the Corridor wall matches our constellation notation." — Astra
\"티어 25. 회랑 벽 표기, 점점 낯익어.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 25. Corridor wall notation, getting familiar." — Astra
\"스물다섯 번째 고리. 벽의 표기를 읽을 수 있을 것 같았다.\" —: "Twenty-fifth ring. It felt like I could read the notation on the wall." — Astra
\"티어 30. 거기까지 간 항로표는 아직 없어.\" — 아스트라: "Tier 30. No route chart has made it that far yet." — Astra
\"서른 번째 고리. 아무도 그리지 않은 칸에 처음 선을 그었다.\" —: "Thirtieth ring. Drew the first line in a square no one had drawn in." — Astra
\"표류 모함 C. 보호가 끝난 뒤의 첫 표적.\" — 아스트라: "Drifting Ship C. First target after protection ends." — Astra
\"가장 작은 표류 모함이 열렸다. 보호 끝, 첫 표적. 딱 맞았어.\": "The smallest drifting ship opened up. Protection over, first target. Just right." — Astra
\"표류 모함 B. 작지도 크지도 않아서 더 까다로워.\" — 사일런: "Drifting Ship B… not small, not big. That makes it trickier." — Silen
"The middle drifting ship opened up. The middle one was guarding the most diligently." — Astra
\"표류 모함 A. 전파가 제일 시끄러운 놈.\" — 사일런: "Drifting Ship A… the noisiest on the air." — Silen
\"가장 큰 표류 모함이 열렸다. 상위권 방어에 맞춘 배였다.\" — 아: "The largest drifting ship opened up. Its defense was set for the top ranks." — Astra
\"센서 연구를 시작하면 예고가 조금 일찍 와.\" — 소나: "Start Sensors research and the warnings come a little earlier." — Sona
\"센서 Lv.2. 보이는 데 끝이 한 칸 밀려났다.\" — 소나: "Sensors Lv.2. The edge of what I can see moved out one cell." — Sona
\"Lv.4 면 잡음 속 신호가 갈라져 보여.\" — 소나: "At Lv.4, you can see signals split out of the noise." — Sona
\"Lv.4. 멀리서 오는 것의 크기까지 짐작된다.\" — 소나: "Lv.4. I can even guess the size of what's coming from far off." — Sona
\"센서 연구 Lv.6. 보이는 데까지가 늘어.\" — 소나: "Sensors research Lv.6. I can see farther now." — Sona
\"탐지 범위 +15%. 소나가 처음으로 고맙다고 했다.\" — 아스트라: "Detection range +15%. Sona said thank you for the first time." — Astra
\"패스파인더를 보내면 레이더 밖도 보여. 돌아오는 건 보고서 한 장이야: "Send a Pathfinder and you can see past the radar. What comes back is a single report." — Sona
\"첫 정찰. 없는 걸로 치던 범위 밖에서 온 보고서는 생각보다 자세했다: "First scouting. The report from beyond the range that counted as nothing was more detailed than I expected." — Sona
\"정찰 열 번. 보고서를 겹쳐 보면 전장이 그려져.\" — 소나: "Ten scoutings. Stack the reports and the battlefield draws itself." — Sona
\"열 장. 겹쳐 놓으니 레이더에 없던 지도가 생겼다.\" — 소나: "Ten sheets. Stacked up, they made a map the radar never had." — Sona
\"정찰 쉰 번. 내 범위 밖 길은 패스파인더들이 외웠을 거야.\" —: "Fifty scoutings. The Pathfinders probably know the ways beyond my range by heart now." — Sona
\"쉰 번. 패스파인더들이 보고서보다 먼저 웃으며 돌아왔다.\" — 소나: "Fifty. The Pathfinders came back smiling before their reports did." — Sona
\"미확인 출격지. 안 보이니까 이름은 정찰한 사람만 알아.\" — 소나: "Unknown site. I can't see it, so only whoever scouted it knows the name." — Sona
\"열 곳. 없는 걸로 치던 자리에 이름을 열 번 적었다.\" — 소나: "Ten places. Where I counted nothing, I wrote down ten names." — Sona
\"쉰 곳. 같은 자리에 두 번 서는 일은 없어.\" — 소나: "Fifty places. You never stand in the same spot twice." — Sona
\"쉰. 이제 안 보이는 자리까지 세면 지도가 두 장이다.\" — 소나: "Fifty. Count the places out of sight now too, and that's two maps." — Sona
\"이백. 보이는 끝, 전장 끝까지 다녀와야 채워져.\" — 소나: "Two hundred. It only fills if you go to the edge of what's visible, the battlefield's edge, and back." — Sona
\"이백. 패스파인더들이 레이더보다 먼저 자리를 짚었다.\" — 소나: "Two hundred. The Pathfinders pinned the spots before the radar did." — Sona
\"오백. 여기부터는 보는 것도 버릇이야.\" — 소나: "Five hundred. From here on, even watching is habit." — Sona
\"오백. 공용 좌표의 신호는 이제 눈 감고도 읽는다.\" — 소나: "Five hundred. I read signals from public coordinates with my eyes closed now." — Sona
\"천. 세어 줄 사람은 나밖에 없겠지.\" — 소나: "A thousand. I'm probably the only one who'll count them." — Sona
\"천. 좌표 장부를 새로 묶었다. 앞 장은 다 낡았어.\" — 소나: "A thousand. I bound a new coordinate ledger. The old pages are worn out." — Sona
\"10세대 넘는 출격지가 가끔 떠. 거긴 적도 오래 버틴 놈들이야.\": "Sites past Gen 10 show up now and then. The defenders there have held out a long time." — Sona
\"10세대. 오래 남은 곳엔 그만한 이유가 있었다.\" — 소나: "Gen 10. Places that last that long had their reasons." — Sona
\"깊은 세대를 열 번. 관측으론 운이 아니라 실력이 되는 횟수야.\": "Deep generations, ten times. By observation, that's the count where luck turns into skill." — Sona
\"열 번. 깊은 곳도 이제 보이는 데라 겁나지 않아.\" — 소나: "Ten. The deep ones are within sight now, so they don't scare me anymore." — Sona
\"다른 도크의 수리 기록도 세고 있어. 공구는 어디서나 닳아.\" —: "Counting other docks' repair logs too. Tools wear down everywhere." — Rivet
"Every dock's repairs added up. Wore out a whole toolbox. Hand me a new one." — Rivet
\"다른 모함의 승전도 같은 기록판에 건다. 포성은 합쳐서 들린다.\": "Other Motherships' wins go on the same board. The guns sound as one." — Volta
\"기록판 한 줄이 모두의 포성으로 찼다. 다음 판도 정시에 열린다.\": "One line of the board filled with everyone's guns. The next match opens on time too." — Volta
\"거함 장갑에 남은 탄흔을 센다. 한 편대의 것이 아니다.\" — 발리: "I count the scars on the Dreadnought's armor. They're not from one squadron." — Ballista
"This many scars piled up. The Dreadnought will remember too — even if not who fired." — Ballista
\"각자 내려간 깊이를 한 장에 겹치는 중. 아직 빈칸이 많아.\" —: "Layering everyone's depth onto one sheet. Still a lot of blanks." — Sona
\"회랑 지도가 한 겹 더 그려졌다. 모두가 내려간 만큼만 보여.\" —: "One more layer drawn on the Corridor map. It shows only as far as everyone's gone down." — Sona
\"다른 모함의 공사 기록도 들어와. 용접 자국은 다 비슷해.\" — 리: "Other motherships' build logs come in too. Weld marks all look alike." — Rivet
\"모든 모함의 뼈대를 합치면 이만큼이야. 다음 층은 더 높게 올리자.\: "Every Mothership's frame put together comes to this. Next deck goes higher." — Rivet
\"다른 격납고의 승급 기록도 훈련표에 옮겨 적고 있어. 다시 본다.\": "I'm copying other hangars' promotion records onto the training chart too. Going over them again." — Minerva
"The spark of promotion filled a page of everyone's training chart. I'll keep the next page blank." — Minerva
\"첫 수리. 공구는 내가 챙겨. 다음 애.\" — 리벳: "First repair. Tools are on me. Next girl." — Rivet
\"첫 수리. 흠집은 남겨 뒀어 — 다음엔 어디를 맞았는지 알게.\" —: "First repair. Left the dent — so next time we know where she got hit." — Rivet
\"교환소 거래 한 번. 환율은 오늘 그대로, 손해 없는 장사예요.\": "One trade at the Exchange. Today's rate is unchanged — a trade with no loss." — Marché
\"첫 거래 감사합니다. 남는 걸 모자란 걸로 바꾸는 건 손해가 아니라: "Thank you for your first trade. Turning surplus into what you lack is not a loss. It is speed." — Marché
\"거래 열 번. 값 보는 눈이 생기실 때예요.\" — 마르셰: "Ten trades. It is about time you developed an eye for prices." — Marché
\"열 번. 이제 흥정 없이도 값이 맞네요.\" — 마르셰: "Ten. Now the price is right without any haggling." — Marché
\"거래 서른 번이면 단골이시죠.\" — 마르셰: "Thirty trades, and you are a regular." — Marché
\"서른 번. 교환소 장부 맨 윗줄은 지휘관님 자리예요.\" — 마르셰: "Thirty. The top line of the Exchange ledger is yours, Commander." — Marché
\"건설 조립 연구 제작 중 하나를 예약해 두면 끝나는 대로 이어서 시작: "Queue up a build, assembly, research, or craft and it starts as soon as the last one ends. I keep the queue." — Serena
\"하던 일 뒤에 다음 거 하나 걸어 뒀네. 자리를 비워도 배는 계속 자: "Hung the next one behind the current job. Ship keeps growing while you're away." — Rivet
\"예약 열 번. 장부대로 가니 라인이 비는 시간이 줄어들 거야.\" —: "Ten queued. Going by the ledger, there'll be less idle time on the lines." — Serena
\"열 번. 장부의 다음 줄은 늘 차 있어.\" — 세레나: "Ten. The next line in the ledger is always filled." — Serena
\"쉰 번이면 순서가 습관이 된다. 장부에선 당연하지.\" — 세레나: "At fifty, the order becomes habit. By the ledger, of course." — Serena
\"쉰 번. 네가 자는 동안에도 모함은 자랐어. 장부에 다 있어.\" —: "Fifty. The Mothership grew even while you slept. It's all in the ledger." — Serena
\"첫 무장. 도크 냄새가 바뀐다.\" — 리벳: "First armament. Dock smells different now." — Rivet
\"장비 다섯 칸. 한 벌이 아니라 편성 하나야.\" — 리벳: "Five gear slots. That's not one kit, that's a squad." — Rivet
\"다섯 칸. 제작대 소리가 격납고까지 들린다.\" — 리벳: "Five slots. You can hear the workbench from the hangar." — Rivet
\"장비 열다섯 칸. 제작대, 휴무 없음.\" — 테스라: "Fifteen gear slots. Workbench: no days off." — Tesla

막았다! 위에서 다 봤어, 셋, 둘, 하나, 끝!: Held! Saw it all from up top — three, two, one, done!
어, 너다! 들어오는 거 위에서 제일 먼저 봤어!: Oh, it's you! Spotted you coming in first, from up here!
Light is something you wear on your back.
This act, I am the lead.
Commander, the audience is that way. Lights.
When Katya's apology is heard, that is Act 2.
Mona pointed out my angle again. She does have a point.
Yellow light suits me best. I do not know why.
I cannot remember who taught me. A backstage matter.
I will not shine a light on your seat, Commander. It would dazzle you.
Today I borrowed someone else's light. It was not bad.
Sometimes I dislike myself for leaning on this yellow light.
This yellow light — whoever taught it to me no longer matters.
I shall turn toward you, Commander. Facing the light.
There is no curtain call. Only you, Commander — please remain.
I will try standing without lights. Since it is before you, Commander.
My silhouette — how was today's staging?
Great. But I want to see your face too, not just the light behind you.
I do not know why I choose that yellow light.
You can lean on it without knowing. The memory comes later.
Who cares what color the lights are.
The shade has covered half my stage.
Someone's standing on the covered side too. Just share it.
무대가 꼭 필요해?: Do you really need a stage?
Returned — curtain down. No applause, thank you.
Held. The lighting angle did its part.
The house was empty, so I could not raise the curtain.
햇빛 같은 조명 좋아~: I like lights that feel like sunshine~
조명 낮아지면 나 자도 돼~?: When the lights go down, can I sleep~?
해바라기 덮개, 리디아가 또 벗겼어~: Lidia took off the sunflower cover again~
정오다! 지금은 뭐든지 할 수 있어~: It's noon! Right now I can do anything~
요한나가 차양 달아 줬어~ 시원해~: Johanna put a visor on me~ so cool~
어두운 회랑은 싫어~ 손 잡고 가 줄 거야~?: I hate dark corridors~ will you hold my hand~?
자다가 좌표 같은 걸 중얼거린대~ 나 몰라~: They say I mumble stuff like coordinates in my sleep~ I dunno~
지휘관 오는 시간은 늘 밝았으면 좋겠어~: I hope it's always bright when you come, Commander~
으음~ 너 옆에선 밤에도 덜 졸려~: Mmm~ next to you I'm less sleepy, even at night~
예전 배는 정오에만 불이 켜졌어~ 그래서 무서웠어~: On the old ship the lights only came on at noon~ so it was scary~
밤에도 깨어 있어 볼게~ 너랑이면~: I'll try staying up at night~ if it's with you~
으음~ 잠꼬대 좌표, 요즘은 다 네 쪽이래~: Mmm~ they say my sleep-talk coordinates all point your way lately~
어둠은 그냥 발밑에 있는 거래~ 이제 안 무서워~: They say darkness is just something at your feet~ I'm not scared anymore~
으음~ 회랑 불 좀 더 밝게 해 주면 안 돼~?: Mmm~ can you make the corridor lights a bit brighter~?
I'll make them brighter. Being scared of the dark isn't strange.
나 자면서 좌표 같은 거 말한대~ 이상하지~?: They say I talk coordinates in my sleep~ weird, right~?
Not weird. When you sleep, you're the one who knows the way.
정오 아닐 때 나 쓸모없지~?: When it's not noon I'm useless, huh~?
You're saving up to go full power at noon. It's okay to rest.
Try staying awake a little longer.
다녀왔어~ 밝을 때 와서 다행이야~: I'm back~ glad I made it while it's bright~
막았어~ 마침 정오였어~: Held~ it just happened to be noon~
오래 걸렸어~ 깜깜했단 말이야~: That took forever~ it was pitch dark, y'know~
바실리사, 오늘은 사뿐!: Vasilisa, light as a feather today!
바실리사 봤어? 방금 쿵 한 거 바실리사야!: Did you see? That thud just now was Vasilisa!
하젤이 또 바닥 메워. 바실리사 반만 미안!: Hazel's filling the floor again. Vasilisa's half sorry!
소피야가 조항에 바실리사를 넣었대! 유명해!: Sofiya put Vasilisa in an article! Vasilisa's famous!
무릎에서 끼익 소리 나. 바실리사 고장 아니야!: Vasilisa's knee goes creak. Vasilisa's not broken!
바실리사 어디서 떨어졌는지 몰라. 지휘관은 알아?: Vasilisa doesn't know where she fell from. Does the Commander?
바실리사가 부서진 조각이면 어떡해?: What if Vasilisa is a broken-off piece?
지휘관 앞에선 바실리사 살살 내려앉을게!: In front of the Commander, Vasilisa will land soft!
Vasilisa thinks she was somewhere high. Somewhere with no ladder.
For the Commander, Vasilisa came down on her own.
부서진 거 아니래. 바실리사가 정했대!: Not broken, they said. Vasilisa decided!
지휘관 옆자리, 바실리사 착륙 지점으로 찜!: The seat next to the Commander — Vasilisa calls dibs as her landing zone!
No Vasilisa mark today. 'Cause the Commander was watching.
바실리사 착륙 점수 몇 점이야? 높지?: What's Vasilisa's landing score? High, right?
자국 깊이로 재면 만점. 다친 데는 없지?: Measured by dent depth, full marks. You're not hurt anywhere?
Wherever you came from, the one who landed here is you.
바실리사 무릎에서 이상한 소리 나. 고장일까?: Vasilisa's knee is making a weird noise. Is she broken?
You're not broken. If it's a crying sound, I'll listen with you.
정련 기사. 연합원들이 보낸 고철을 정련로에서 녹여 합금으로 만든다. 녹: Refinery engineer. She melts down the scrap that alliance members send in the Refinery and turns it into alloy. A gourmet, she tastes out how each batch will turn out by the mark of the ship that sent it, before anything is melted. Chatty and fussy, she will not say a word all day if someone mixes in just any mark.
Today's scrap is a little salty.
Just one taste before I melt it.
It is complete. The burners will have a deeper flavor now.
This alloy—can you guess which ship's mark it bears? The finish is sweet.
Guessing's your job. Tell me what it tastes like.
Melting them together gives more. Still, it feels like a bit of a waste.
It's a waste because every mark tastes different, right?
조립 기술관. 부품 공장 라인에서 연합원이 보낸 합금으로 부품을 찍어 낸: Assembly technician. On the Parts Factory line she stamps out parts from the alloy alliance members send. An invention fanatic who tries putting a rotor on anything, she shoves a new invention at every commander who drops by. She would rather change the line than keep it running, so Rosa and Yvette are always holding her back.
봐봐! 이거 돈다, 돈다!: Look, look! It spins, it spins!
위잉! 여기도 달까?: Whirrr! Should I put one here too?
특허 내도 돼? 응? 응?: Can I patent it? Huh? Huh?
완공! 라인 빨라졌다! 다음은 문짝에 회전자!: Done! The line got faster! Next up, a rotor on the door!
부품 라인에 회전자 달았어! 빨라졌지? 그치?: I put a rotor on the parts line! It's faster, right? Right?
Changed it again. Leave it alone and you'd go stir-crazy, huh.
Put it back the way it was.
Just show me the parts numbers.
꿈에서 본 도면이 있는데, 여기 라인으론 못 만들어. 아깝다!: There's this blueprint I saw in a dream, but this line can't make it. Such a waste!
Draw it anyway, even if you can't build it. It came out of your dream.
Just hand it off to another ship.
합성 화학관. 연료 합성소를 맡아 출격에 드는 연료를 만든다. 한 방울까: Synthesis chemist. She runs the Fuel Synthesizer and makes the fuel that sorties burn. A miser who measures every last drop with a dropper, she sends a lecture along with every sortie. Yet projections, which take no fuel, she sends out without holding back. She calls the girls "child."
Three drops from the dropper, that's all you get.
A projection? That's free. Go as much as you like.
The tank got bigger, child. Still, waste not.
출격 한 번에 연료가 이만큼이란다. 알고 보내는 게지?: One sortie takes this much fuel, you know. You do know that when you send them out, don't you?
You don't hold back at all with projections. You know where to save.
기록에 없는 통이 하나 있는데, 늘 차 있구나. 별일이지?: There's one drum that isn't in the records, and it's always full. Odd, isn't it?
Don't throw it out. Whatever you save, you save for a reason.
동력 기관장. 발전소를 맡아 배 전체에 전력을 댄다. 전력이 모자라면 다: Chief of power. She runs the Power Plant and supplies the whole ship with power. When power runs short, every other system slows down. An eccentric experimenter who boasts that the keepers woke up thanks to her power. Only Sella has never once answered her.
결론은 하나, 내 전력!: There is only one conclusion: my power!
폐열은 부산물이란 말이지!: Waste heat is a by-product, you see!
완공! 실험 대성공, 위대한 전력이 또 늘었다!: Complete! The experiment is a grand success—my magnificent power grows once more!
전력이 오르면 다들 깨어나지! 내 전력 덕이라고, 보라고!: When the power rises, everyone wakes up! It's all thanks to my power, you see—behold!
네 덕인 거 알아. 너를 깨운 쪽도 궁금하지 않아?: I know it's thanks to you. Don't you wonder who woke you?
That's a bit of an exaggeration.
Just tell me the power numbers.
셀라 녀석, 내가 깨웠다고 딱 한 번만 말해 주면 좋겠는데!: If only that Sella would say it, just once—that I woke her up!
It's not about winning. You want Sella to acknowledge you.
창고 관리관. 저장고를 맡아 쌓아 둘 수 있는 양을 늘린다. 들어오는 상: Depot keeper. She runs Storage and raises how much it can hold. She stamps every incoming crate "Received" and checks the mark of the ship that sent it. Businesslike and cynical, but fair to everyone. Only one crate has ever gone unstamped.
Storage nearly full. No room left to stamp.
Running out of places to stamp must bug you most of all.
One unmarked crate. Sender field's blank.
It's the one crate you couldn't stamp, so it keeps nagging at you.
정비 반장. 정비 도크를 맡아 다친 기체를 고치고 제작대를 돌린다. 쇠보: Dock chief. She runs the Repair Dock, fixing damaged frames and keeping the workbench going. A rough-hewn carpenter type who trusts wooden pegs over steel, she teaches fitting before welding. At night, repairs nobody touched start on their own, and Hazel never likes it.
Floor's gouged again. I'll fill it.
Done. Nobody lays a hand here but me.
또 저절로 수리가 시작됐다. 누가 손댔냐?: Repairs started on their own again. Who touched it?
It makes you mad because it's your dock. But you still watch it through to the end.
It got fixed, so who cares.
The workbench is my dock. Yvette's got her hands on it again.
You can't stand others touching it. But you know how to share, too.
Just hurry up with the crafting.
격납 관제관. 격납고를 맡아 소녀들이 쉬는 칸을 늘린다. 칸이 모자라면: Hangar controller. She runs the Hangar and adds more slots where the girls rest. A puzzle lover who invented "slot sharing": splitting one slot by time when there are not enough. Once she fits everything in with no gaps, the first thing she does is clap. She never leaves an empty slot alone.
이 조각, 어디 끼울까요?: This piece—where shall I fit it?
완공이에요! 새 칸 생겼어요!: It is complete! We have a new slot!
칸이 하나 모자라요. 나눠 쓰면 들어갈 것 같은데요!: We are one slot short. If we share, I think it will fit!
Being short actually excites you, huh? It's your puzzle, so I'll leave it to you.
The more I split slots, the more the names overlap. Zhenya's roll call got tangled again.
You feel bad for tangling it. Try sorting it out with Zhenya.
항해 지휘관. 통제실을 맡아 출격 편성이 나갈 자리를 늘린다. 배가 스스: Navigation commander. She runs the Control Room and adds more sortie slots for squads to go out. Since the ship moves on its own, she cannot set its course; she can only forecast. When a forecast is wrong, she walks one lap around the Bridge. Marina counts those laps, and Cassandra never erases her forecast chart.
I will go take a lap.
It is complete. There are more slots, yet I still do not know our course.
I tried forecasting the next bend, but I was probably wrong again this time.
Still trying to read a ship you can't steer. That's so you.
Call me when you get one right.
We have more sortie slots. The ship still does not listen to me, however.
Maybe not the ship, but the squads go out by your chart.
Don't be mad at the ship.
Let's upgrade the Control Room more.
훈련 교관. 훈련장을 맡아 소녀들을 한꺼번에 단련시킨다. 훈련 중에 부름: Drill instructor. She runs the Training Ground and trains the girls all at once. If the call bell rings during training, a projection's strength is cut in half, so she builds the schedule around the hours when the bell rings less. A fiery coach who rarely takes the whistle out of her mouth.
완공! 마당 넓어졌다! 다 나와!: Done! The yard got bigger! Everybody out!
훈련 중에 종이 울리면 힘이 반이야! 훈련 줄일까, 말까!: If the bell rings during training, strength drops by half! Cut training or not?!
I trust the schedule you built around the bell.
너도 마당 한 바퀴 뛸래? 호루라기는 내가 불게!: Wanna run a lap of the yard too? I'll blow the whistle!
If you run too. Don't just blow the whistle.
교환 상인. 교환소를 맡아 자원을 바꿔 주고 그 한도를 넓힌다. 부름종이: Trader. She runs the Exchange, swapping resources and widening its limit. She also keeps the book that sets odds on which girl will arrive each time the call bell rings. She always takes stakes fairly, but on the ghost book she takes not a single coin.
손님, 한 판 거시죠?: Care to place a wager, honored guest?
The Olga round-trip book is fifty-fifty, yes indeed~
I called the completion book, yes indeed~ Heh heh.
다음 부름종엔 누가 닿을지, 거시겠어요? 배당 좋아요~: Who will arrive at the next call bell—care to wager? The odds are good~
It's not the result you like. It's that moment the bell rings.
The ghost book takes no stakes. Strange, is it not? Heh heh.
You want at least one book you can't put a price on.
포격 지휘관. 포탑을 맡아 습격을 맞받아친다. 이 배엔 습격이 드물어 쏠: Gunnery commander. She runs the Turret and returns fire on raids. Raids are rare on this ship, so with almost nothing to shoot, she spends her days critiquing other people's guns. Only in the alliance Dreadnought squadron does she get to fire freely, and even then she loudly corrects the turret angles of the ships beside her.
Hey. This is how you fire.
That ship's angle—wrong, I tell you.
Done. I'll break in the barrel myself.
이 배엔 습격이 드물다고. 포탑은 왜 올리는 거야?: Raids are rare on this ship, I tell you. Why upgrade the Turret?
Even with nothing to shoot, you're the one waiting for the one shot that protects us.
Did you see the gun angles on the ships next to us in the Dreadnought squadron? All wrong.
Your critiques are really just a way of recognizing good shooting.
대공 사수. 대공 기관포 탑을 맡아 몰려드는 작은 기체 무리를 털어 낸다: AA gunner. She runs the AA Gun tower and shakes off swarms of small craft. A gentle gardener who grows potted plants on top of the tower, she turns into a shouting gunner when a swarm comes. The seeds in her pots came from a supply crate.
The tower got taller~ The leaves will drink in more sun.
대공 탑에 화분이라니, 이상하죠? 그래도 예쁘죠?: Potted plants on an AA tower—odd, I know. Still, they are pretty, right?
I like that someone who yells at swarms is so gentle with flowers.
사격에 방해 안 돼?: Don't they get in the way of your shooting?
The mark on the seed crate is unfamiliar. They say it is not from any member's ship.
Wherever it came from, if it blooms in your hands, it's this ship's flower.
포대장. 레일건 포대를 맡아 멀리서 무거운 한 발로 끊어 낸다. 모든 걸: Battery chief. She runs the Railgun Battery and cuts things off from afar with one heavy shot. An expressionless precisionist who speaks of everything in units, she reports her charge down to the decimal point. She and Grizel are rivals, old gun against new, and the records always show a gap of one shot.
Complete. Barrel alignment confirmed. No anomalies.
4 seconds to full charge. Requesting target designation.
숫자 말고. 그리젤보다 한 발 앞서고 싶은 거지?: Forget the numbers. You want to be one shot ahead of Grizel, right?
One coil, mark not from a member ship. Unmeasurable.
Even if there's one thing you can't measure, your gun is accurate.
전파 관제사. ECM 방벽을 맡아 들어오는 신호를 흐려 배를 감춘다. 근: Signal controller. She runs the ECM Barrier, blurring incoming signals to hide the ship. On duty she tapes her mouth shut and does not say a word, but once her shift ends, words pour out of her like a waterfall. The Barrier does not go out with the Dreadnought squadron, so she pouts whenever it comes up.
끝! 이제 말해도 되지?: Done! I can talk now, right?
그래서 있잖아, 그게—: So, like, listen, the thing is—
…(완공. 테이프 너머로 엄지를 든다): …(Complete. She gives a thumbs-up over the tape)
…(근무 중이라며 입의 테이프를 가리킨다): …(She points at the tape over her mouth: on duty)
I'll hear it all when you're done. Guard the barrier for now.
끝났다! 오늘 방벽에 뭐가 걸렸냐면, 아 잠깐, 처음부터 말할게!: I'm done! You know what got caught in the barrier today— oh wait, let me start from the beginning!
Tell me everything. I know you'll leave out Lada's part, though.
Give it to me as a report.
탐지 관측사. 레이더를 맡아 멀리서 다가오는 것을 먼저 보고 습격을 미리: Sensor observer. She runs the Radar, spotting what approaches from afar and warning of raids in advance. A fusser who pins a theory on every dot on the screen. It was Agata who first said this ship follows an old track.
이거 수상하다니까!: I'm telling you, this is suspicious!
완공! 범위 넓어졌어, 점이 막 보여!: Done! The range got wider—dots everywhere!
이 점, 사흘째 같은 자리야! 수상하지? 그치?: This dot's been in the same spot for three days! Suspicious, right? Right?
Give it a theory. Even when you're wrong, your theories are the most fun.
All this fuss over one dot.
레이더 범위가 늘었어! 습격 예고도 빨라졌고, 이론도 늘었어!: The radar range went up! Raid warnings are faster, and I've got more theories!
The farther you see, the more theories you'll have.
금고 관리인. 지하 창고를 맡아 습격 때 빼앗기지 않을 몫을 지킨다. 이: Vault keeper. She runs the Underground Vault, guarding the share that cannot be taken in a raid. Raids are rare on this ship, so she is always bored. That is why she changes the vault code every day and plays crack-the-vault with Ruth. She yawns all the time, but her hands are busy when it comes to changing the code.
Such a pain… Locked it anyway.
Done… Even harder to open now? Probably.
No raids. The vault says it's bored. Me too.
루트가 계속 오게 하려고 번호 바꾸는 거지?: You change the code so Ruth keeps coming back, don't you?
No raids is a good thing.
Protection rate went up. But there's nothing to guard. Sleepy.
Guarding when there's nothing to guard is the most boring—and the most important.
I'll leave the Underground Vault as is.
광산 연구 주임. 합금 부품 연료가 나오는 양을 늘리는 광산 연구가 아고: Mining research lead. Mining research that raises the output of alloy, parts, and fuel is Agona's job. A competition fiend who grills every visiting commander about the research levels of the later-numbered ships and tries to beat them. She competes with Trixie in invention against research, and with Carta in pushing ahead against hiding.
완공! 속도 올랐어. 저쪽보다 빨라? 빨라?: Done! Speed's up. Faster than them? Faster?
뒤 번호 배들 연구, 어디까지 갔대? 빨리 말해 봐!: How far have the later-numbered ships gotten in research? Tell me, quick!
It's not that you want to win. You want to set them side by side.
Tosca rebutted me again. But… I think she's right. So annoying.
Admitting it even when it stings—that's because you really love research.
항법 연구 주임. 출격 편성이 오가는 길을 짧게 깎는 연구를 맡았다. 남: Navigation research lead. Her research shaves down the routes sortie squads travel. A shy precisionist whose hand starts drawing charts the moment she tries to speak in front of others, so her reports are always replaced by chart number such-and-such. When the words get stuck, she says the first sound twice.
I-I will give it to you as a chart.
C-complete… There is one more chart now.
